ingredients_name: Kabuli Chana (White Chickpeas), Black Eyed Beans (Lobia), Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas), Carrot (Gajjar), Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum), Potato (Aloo), Onion, Whole Wheat Brown Bread, Mint Leaves (Pudina), Garlic, Lemon, Salt, Turmeric powder (Haldi), Cumin powder (Jeera), Chaat Masala Powder, Red Chilli powder, Oil
ingredients_quantity: 1/4 cup Kabuli Chana (White Chickpeas) , soaked & cooked  1/4 cup Black Eyed Beans (Lobia) , soaked & cooked  1/4 cup Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas) , soaked & cooked  1 Carrot (Gajjar) , finely chopped  1 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) , finely chopped  1 Potato (Aloo) , boiled and mashed  1 Onion , finely chopped  1 Whole Wheat Brown Bread Mint Leaves (Pudina) , small bunch, finely chopped  3 cloves Garlic , grated  1 Lemon , juice Salt , to taste  1/4 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  1/2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera)  1 teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder  1/2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder Oil , as needed
instructions: To begin making the Dal and Vegetable Kebab Recipe, soak the dal for 8 hours, cook them until soft in a pressure cooker for 2 whistles and let the pressure release naturally. Drain the excess water and coarsely mash them using a food processor or a hand blender. Powder the bread by grinding in a mixer. Chop mint and any other leaves included for the vegetables.Combine all the ingredients except the oil. Check the salt and spice levels and adjust to suit your taste.Take a 6 medium size bamboo skewers and soak it in water for an hour. This is needed else the sticks will burn.Take an oven tray and cover it with aluminum foil and brush with oil. Shape the kebabs into cylinders and slice the skewers into the vegetable kebab.  Shape the vegetable kebabs and press them so it holds well.Place the Dal and Vegetable Kebab on the greased baking tray. Brush the vegetable kebabs with oil and refrigerate in for at least one hour.Preheat the oven for 180 C for about 10 minutes. Place the kebabs in the oven and make for about 20 minutes until golden brown. Keep checking if the bottom portion of kebab is cooked. If it's cooked and crispy turn around to cook the other side. If needed you may brush the oil.Ensure all the sides are crispy and inside is soft, that’s the indication that the kebab is cooked. Remove the Vegetable Kebab from the oven and serve warm.Serve the Dal and Vegetable Kebab Recipe along with Mint Chutney and a cup of Filter Coffee as a tea time snack or as an appetizer for parties.

name: Chicken Tikki Recipe - Chicken Cutlet
description: If you ever happen to make something delicious which goes well with rain, these Chicken Tikkis are just perfect. Chicken cooked with spicy masala and then shaped into tikkis, sound only so yummy.
ingredients_name: Chicken, Onion, Coriander (Dhania) Leaves, Ginger Garlic Paste, Rice flour, Salt, Whole Egg, Whole Wheat Bread crumbs, Oil, Garam masala powder, Red Chilli powder, Turmeric powder (Haldi), Coriander Powder (Dhania), Cumin powder (Jeera)
ingredients_quantity: 400 Grams Chicken , minced  1 Onion , finely chopped  4 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , finely chopped  1 teaspoon Ginger Garlic Paste  2 Tablespoons Rice flour Salt , to taste  1 Whole Egg , whisked (for coating)  1 Cup Whole Wheat Bread crumbs  2 Tablespoons Oil , for shallow fry Dry spices 1 Tablespoon Garam masala powder  1 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  1 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  1 teaspoon Coriander Powder (Dhania)  1/2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera)
instructions: To begin making the Chicken Tikki Recipe, In a small bowl, whisk the egg and keep aside. Take minced chicken in a big bowl. Add in all the spices mentioned including garam masala powder, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and mix well.Now add in ginger garlic paste, chopped onions, chopped coriander leaves, rice flour, 1/4 cup bread crumbs and salt to taste. Mix well.If you find the mixture is too sticky to make balls, add in more bread crumbs. Take about lemon size ball out of mixture and shape it into round shape.Dip each ball into the egg mixture and dust them in the breadcrumbs, pressing a little while dusting to give it a flat cutlet or patty shape.Heat a skillet and add a tablespoon oil. Arrange all the patties on top and drizzle more oil on top of each patty.Fry on medium heat till crisp on both the sides. This takes roughly 5 minutes on each side. Remove on a plate and serve hot.Serve Chicken Tikki along with Dhaniya Pudina Chutney, Tomato Chutney or any other chutney of your choice and some pickled onions.

name: Jeera Miri Kolambi Recipe - Cumin & Black Pepper Prawns
description: Jeera-Miri Kolambi Recipe which is also called as Cumin & Black Pepper Prawns is a similar recipe to the Jeera Miri Chicken. It has the kick of the pepper along with the heat of the red chillies. There are also some curry leaves in this recipe which adds more flavour to this recipe.
ingredients_name: Prawns, Onion, Tomato, Curry leaves, Oil, Coriander (Dhania) Leaves, Ginger, Garlic, Turmeric powder (Haldi), Dry Red Chillies, Whole Black Peppercorns, Salt, Malt vinegar
ingredients_quantity: 300 grams Prawns , shelled and deveined  1 Onion , finely chopped  1 Tomato , finely chopped  5 Curry leaves  4 tablespoons Oil  2 tablespoons Coriander (Dhania) Leaves For the spice paste: 1 inch Ginger  2 cloves Garlic  1 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  2 Dry Red Chillies  10 Whole Black Peppercorns Salt , to taste  1-2 teaspoons Malt vinegar
instructions: To begin making Jeera Miri Kolambi Recipe (Cumin & Black Pepper Prawns), grind all the ingredients for the spice paste including ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, dry red chillies, whole black peppercorns, salt, malt vinegar with about 2 tablespoons water. Make a smooth spice paste.Marinade the prawns with the paste and add some salt. Keep aside.Heat the oil in a kadai. On a medium high heat, add the curry leaves and the onions. Stir occasionally.When the onions are caramelised, add the tomato paste or chopped tomato. Cook on medium heat till the tomatoes are mushy and the onions and tomatoes have come together.Add the prawns along with all the spice paste they were marinaded in. Add about 1/4 cup of water and cook on high heat till the prawns are done and all the water has evaporated. (If you want, you can add more water and you can make a gravy dish from the same prawns as well.Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.Serve Jeera Miri Kolambi Recipe (Cumin & Black Pepper Prawns) with some Coconut Rice and Raw Mango Raita Recipe or along with Green Chutney as a party appetizer served with Cucumbertini Recipe for cocktail party.

name: Masoor Dal Makhani Recipe - Masoor Dal Makhani Recipe
description: Masoor dal makhani is a delicious, creamy and healthy recipe, which is very high in protein. You can make it for your daily food. You can make this dal on your house parties or any special occasion. It is not only healthy, but also very tasty.
ingredients_name: Lentils, onions, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, bay leaves, long, cumin, cinnamon, garam masala powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, ghee, cream, salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup 1 cup lentil dal 1 onion, finely chop 1 tomato 6 long garlic 2 inch ginger 1 bottom 2 long leaves 1 tsp cumin 1 teaspoon cumin 1 cinnamon 2 teaspoon garam masala powder 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 2 teaspoon coriander powder 2 tablespoons coriander powder 2 tablespoons 2 tablespoons 2 teaspoon 2 teaspoon 2 teaspoon 2 teaspoon 2 teaspoon of 2 teaspoon of crammum 2 teaspoon of cams
instructions: To make Masoor Dal Makhni recipe, first wash the lentil dal thoroughly. Now soak the lentil dal for 30 minutes. Now heat a pressure cooker ghee. Put cinnamon, long, cumin seeds and let cumin seeds fall. Now add onion to it and cook till they turn brown. Now add ginger and garlic in a habitat and grind it. Pour this mixture in the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Now add tomatoes, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder and cook till the tomatoes become soft. Now add lentil lentils and cook for 30 seconds. Add salt according to water, taste and turn off the cooker. Cook till 4 to 5 cities and let the pressure come out automatically. Open, mix and serve. Serve the Masoor Dal Makhani recipe with onion ladyfingers, gourd raita and phulka for dinner.

name: टमाटर लहसुन की चटनी रेसिपी - Tomato Garlic Chutney Recipe
description: टमाटर लहसुन की चटनी रेसिपी एक खट्टी मीठी चटनी है जिसमे टमाटर के साथ साथ लहसुन का भी प्रयोग किया जाता है. आप इस चटनी को अपने खाने के साथ परोस सकते है या अपने रोल और सैंडविच में भी लगा सकते है. इसमें तेल का प्रयोग नहीं होता है और आप इसे 1 वीक के लिए फ्रिज में स्टोर कर सकते है.
ingredients_name: टमाटर, लहसुन, पूरी काली मिर्च, दालचीनी, हरी मिर्च, काजू, गुड़, लाल मिर्च पाउडर , निम्बू का रस, नमक, शक्कर

instructions: टमाटर लहसुन की चटनी रेसिपी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले साड़ी सामग्री तैयार कर ले. एक कढ़ाई में टमाटर, लहसुन, पूरी काली मिर्च, दालचीनी, हरी मिर्च, काजू, गुड़ डाले और टमाटर के नरम होने तक पका ले. टमाटर के नरम होने के बाद, इसमें शक्कर, नमक, लाल मिर्च पाउडर डाले और टमाटर चटनी के गाढ़ा होने तक पका ले. गैस बंद कर ले. इसमें निम्बू का रस डाले और मिला ले. परोसे। टमाटर लहसुन की चटनी रेसिपी को घी रोस्ट डोसा और फ़िल्टर कॉफ़ी के साथ सुबह के नाश्ते के लिए परोसे।

name: wealthy ministry chicken taka recipe - Dhaniya Pudina Chicken Tikka Recip
description: There is a lot of time that we have a desire to eat some taste, but it takes a lot of time to make it, but it is a dish that you can make in a very short time. If green chutney is ready in your fridge, then it becomes even easier to make coriander mint chicken tikka recipe.
ingredients_name: Chicken, lemon juice, chaat masala powder, oil, green coriander, mint, hung curd, green chillies, ginger, garlic, salt
ingredients_quantity: Cut 250 grams chicken, cut 2 teaspoons lemon juice chaat masala powder, oil according to the use according to the use, 5 twig coriander 3 twig mint for meriting 2 tablespoons 2 tablespoons Hungs 2 green chillies 1/2 teaspoon of ginger, tighten 4 bud garlic salt, according to taste, as per taste,
instructions: To make coriander mint chicken tikka recipe, first clean the chicken thoroughly and wash it. Grind small and pierce with the help of fork. Keep separately. To make the marine spice, add green coriander, mint, hung curd, green chillies, ginger, garlic, salt and make a paste in a mixer grinder. Add chicken to it and mix well. Keep it in the fridge for 1 hour. Now heat oil in a grill pan. Add marinated chicken to it and mix well. Cook well from all sides. Light to brown layer will start coming on the chicken and the reality will also become soft. After cooking, take out in a bowl, add chaat masala, lemon juice and mix well. Serve coriander mint chicken tikka recipe with curd peppermint chutney and vinegar onion to your house parties.

name: Almond Milk Recipe - Badam Milk Recipe
description: In India, you will see people beaten cold almond milk in summer. You will find people selling almond milk on the road. In this, milk is flavored with almonds, which looks very tasty. You can also serve it to your guests.
ingredients_name: Almonds, milk, sugar, cardamom, saffron
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup almonds, soaked 1 liter milk 1 cup sugar 2 cardamom, break 1 tsp saffron
instructions: To make almond milk, first take out the almond peel and cut it. Now put them in the mixer grinder and grind them. Put the paste separately and add milk in a saucepan and keep it to boil. After boiling, add almonds, cardamom, sugar, saffron and cook till it thickens. Serve cold or hot. Serve the almond milk recipe with Aloo Poha for breakfast in the morning.

name: Dal Vangi Recipe
description: Dal Wangi recipe is a delicious dal in which brinjal has also been used along with lentils. This is an easy dish that is made in every Maharashtrian house. Its spices are used in it, which makes it even more tasty.
ingredients_name: Arhar dal, brinjal, green chilli, garlic, cumin, dry coconut, kokum, jaggery, Goda masala, asafetida, kadhi leaves, rye, turmeric powder, salt, green coriander, oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup arhar dal 4 brinjal, stem cut 3 green chillies, straight and thin cut 3 bud garlic 1/2 teaspoon cumin 2 tablespoons 2 tablespoons dry coconut, small pieces, take 1 teaspoon of jaggery, tighten 1 teaspoon of Goda masala 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida 7/2 teaspoon 7/2 teaspoon spoon spoon Green coriander, finely chop oil, according to use
instructions: To make dal wangi recipe, first of all add 2-1/2 cups of water, cocum, turmeric powder and salt in a pressure cooker. Cook till 2 cities. Reduce the heat and let it cook for 5 minutes. Turn off the gas. Let the prasher come out on its own and keep it separately.  Now add cumin seeds and grind it. Now add green chillies, garlic, coconut and make a paste. Cut the bangon and keep it separately in salt water. Heat oil in a pan. Add rye to it and let it fall. After the opinion, add a mixture of curry leaves and coconut garlic to it. After 1 minute add turmeric powder and brinjal to it. Add salt and mix it well. Cover the pan and cook until the brinjal cooks well. Sprinkle a little water that will help in cooking the brinjal. After the brinjal ripening, add cooked dal, Goda masala and mix well. Add some water, let the boiled come and put it in the bowl. Garnish with green coriander and serve. Serve the dal wangi recipe with potatoes, tomato onion and cucumber raita and bhakri for dinner.

name: Kulith Dal Recipe - Horsegram Dal Recipe
description: Kulith Dal is an easy and simple dal that is made in every Indian house. This lentil is enough to lose weight and is also considered good for the stomach. This pulses rich in protein are also good for diabetic people. Along with being healthy, it is also very tasty to eat.
ingredients_name: Kulith lentils, water, turmeric powder, salt, ghee, rye, cumin, asafoetida, ginger garlic paste, onion, tomato, red chili powder, coriander powder, green coriander
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup kulith dal 3 cup water 1 tbsp of turmeric powder salt, 1 tbsp ghee as per taste 1/2 teaspoon 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1/4 teaspoon asafetida 1 tbsp of ginger garlic paste, cut 1 onion, cut 1 tomato, cut 1 tomato, 1 tsp red spoon powder 1 tone powder, coriander coriander For
instructions: To make the Kulith Dal recipe, first soak Kulith Dal in 1 cup of water overnight. Now pour it with 3 cups of water, salt, turmeric powder in a pressure cooker, close the cooker and cook till 6 to 7 cities. Heat ghee in a pan. Add rye, cumin and let it fall in it. After the rye, add asafetida to it and cook for 10 seconds. Now add ginger garlic paste and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Now add onion and cook until the onion is soft. After the onion is soft, add tomatoes, red chili powder, salt, coriander powder and cook till the tomatoes become soft. Cover the pan and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Now add lentils to it, covered the pan and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Turn off the gas and garnish with green coriander. Serve the Kulith Dal recipe for dinner with Bhendi Masala, Gourd Raita and Phulka.

name: Sindhi Sai Bhaji Recipe - Sindhi Sai Bhaji Recipe
description: Sindhi Sai Bhaji Recipe is a traditional recipe that is made in every Sindhi house. This is a healthy recipe as green vegetables and other vegetables are also used along with lentils. You can use vegetables of your choice in it. Ghee and garlic are also used which gives it even better flavor.
ingredients_name: Spinach, fenugreek, heart leaves, gram dal, green moong dal, carrots, green beans, brinjal, gourd, onion, tomato, raw mango, ginger, green chilli, ghee, salt, turmeric powder, coriander powder, garlic, red chili powder, ghee
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup spinach, finely chop 1 cup fenugreek, finely chop 1/2 cup heart leaves, finely chop 1/4 cup gram dal, wash it and soak 1/4 cup green moong dal, split, wash and soak 1/2 cup of carrots, finely chop 1/2 cup green beans, finely chop 1/2 cup, chop 1/2 cup, bright, bright, brighter, finely cut 1/2 cup, chop it, fine Finely chop 1 tomato, finely chop 1 raw mango, finely chop, fine 1 inch ginger, finely chop 2 green chillies, finely chop 1 tablespoon ghee salt, 1 teaspoon of turmeric powder according to taste 1 tablespoon coriander powder, 4 buds of garlic, finely chop 1 tablebg pound
instructions: To make Sindhi Sai Bhaji recipe, first wash the gram dal and green moong dal and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Wash and cut the saree vegetables thoroughly and keep it separately. Heat oil in a pressure cooker. Add onion to it and cook until it becomes soft. Now add ginger, green chillies and cook for 30 seconds. After 30 seconds, add carrots, beans, brinjal, gourd, tomatoes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add gram dal, green moong dal, coriander powder, turmeric powder, salt and cook for 1 minute. Now add spinach, fenugreek and mix. Add 2 cups of water, close the cooker and cook till 4 to 5 cities. Turn off the gas and let the pressure come out on its own. Mash with the help of Masher and keep it separately. For tempering, heat ghee in the tempering pan. Add garlic and cook until it becomes light brown. Now add red chili to it and turn off the gas after 10 seconds. Dale, mix and serve the tempering in Bhaji. Serve the Sindhi Sai Bhaji recipe with Bhuga rice, Sidhi Koki and Gourd Raita for the day's dinner.

name: गोभी मूंग दाल रेसिपी - Cauliflower Moong Dal Recipe
description: गोभी मूंग दाल रेसिपी एक आरामदायक रेसिपी है जो बनाने में बहुत आसान है और इसमें रोज के सामग्री की आवश्यकता होती है. इसमें हरा धनिया, हल्दी पाउडर और जीरा पाउडर का प्रयोग किया जाता है जो इसको और भी ताज़ा स्वाद देता है. इसमें हमने गोभी का प्रयोग किया है, लेकिन अगर आप चाहे तो अपनी पसंद की सब्ज़ी का भी प्रयोग कर सकते है.
ingredients_name: पिली मूंग दाल , गोभी, हल्दी पाउडर, हरी मिर्च, जीरा पाउडर , प्याज, नमक, टमाटर, तेल, अदरक, हरा धनिया, गरम मसाला पाउडर
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप पिली मूंग दाल  , स्प्लिट  1 गोभी  1 छोटा चम्मच हल्दी पाउडर  3 हरी मिर्च  1 बड़ा चम्मच जीरा पाउडर   1 प्याज , काट ले नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  2 टमाटर  1 बड़ा चम्मच तेल  1 छोटा चम्मच अदरक , कस ले  2 बड़े चम्मच हरा धनिया  1 छोटा चम्मच गरम मसाला पाउडर
instructions: गोभी मूंग दाल रेसिपी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले मूंग दाल को एक कढ़ाई में डाले और 2 से 3 मिनट के लिए सेक ले. अब दाल को पानी में 15 से 20 मिनट के लिए भिगो दे. पानी निकाल दे और दाल को एक सॉसपैन में डाल दे. इसमें 4 कप पानी, नमक, हल्दी पाउडर, जीरा पाउडर, हरी मिर्च डाले और दाल के पकने तक या 15 से 20 मिनट के लिए पका ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल या घी गरम करें। इसमें प्याज डाले और उनके नरम होने तक पका ले. प्याज के नरम होने के बाद अदरक, टमाटर थोड़ा पानी डाले और मसाला को पकने दे.टमाटर के नरम और मसाला मिल जाने के बाद गोभी डाले और मिला ले. 1 मिनट बाद पकी हुई दाल डाले, मिलाए और कढ़ाई को ढक दे.  15 से 20 मिनट तक पकाए या जब तक गोभी नरम नहीं हो जाती।  उसके बाद गरम मसाला डाले, मिलाए और परोसे। गोभी मूंग दाल रेसिपी को सेव टमाटर की सब्ज़ी, लौकी रायता और फुल्के के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Dal Bhajia Recipe - Vegetable Dal Pakora Recipe
description: Dal Bhajia recipe is a snack full of taste, in which moong dal and gram dal are used. In this, you can also use vegetables of your choice. You can fry Bhajia in oil or you can also fry them in Paniaram pan. Paniaram PAN is a healthy way because very little oil is used in it.
ingredients_name: Chana dal, yellow moong dal, green chillies, ginger, cabbage, carrots, onion, green coriander, lemon juice, cumin powder, chaat masala powder, baking powder, salt, oil
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup gram dal 1/2 cup yellow moong dal, split 2 green chillies, finely chop 1 inch ginger, tighten 1/4 cup cabbage, finely chop 1 carrot, tighten 1 onion, finely chop 1 twig green coriander, finely chop 1 small teaspoon of nimbu juice 1 small spoon pudding 1/2 small spoon Spoon baking powder salt, oil according to taste, use
instructions: To make dal Bhajia recipe, first soak the dal for 2 hours. Take out the water and add ginger, green chillies with lentils in a mixer grinder, make some water and paste. Add this batter to the bowl and add cabbage, carrots, onion, green coriander, lemon juice, cumin powder, chaat masala powder, baking powder, salt and mix it. Now heat oil in a pan. Put 1 tablespoon batter in the pan and deep fry. Cook till the golden brown and take it out on the kitchen towel, so that it absorbs more oil. To make Paniaram PAN, add oil to every cavity of paniram pan. Add quail to it and cook until the brown is golden from all sides. Serve. Serve the dal Bhajia recipe with coriander mint chutney and a cup of garam masala tea during rainy days.

name: Homemade Canape Papdi Chaat Recipe
description: The Homemade Canape Papdi Chaat Recipe is a very exciting and fun way to eat chaat that is loaded with all the healthy ingredients like sprouts. The canape chaat makes a great inclusion in your late evening "chaat party". The canapes are not just easy to handle and pop into mouth, they can also be made ahead and stored. Impress your guests of all ages with this delicious Homemade Canape Papdi Chaat Recipe.
ingredients_name: Gram flour (besan), Instant Oats (Oatmeal), Whole Wheat Flour, Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder, Oil, Cooking soda, Salt, Water, Green Moong Sprouts, Chickpea Sprouts, Onion, Tomato, Coriander (Dhania) Leaves, Lemon juice, Chaat Masala Powder, Green Chilli, Sev
ingredients_quantity: For the canape 1 cup Gram flour (besan)  1 1/2 tablespoons Instant Oats (Oatmeal) , ground to a fine flour  1 1/2 tablespoons Whole Wheat Flour  1 tablespoon Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder  1 tablespoon Oil  1/2 teaspoon Cooking soda Salt , to taste Water , as required For making chaat 1/2 cup Green Moong Sprouts  1/2 cup Chickpea Sprouts  1 Onion , finely chopped  1 Tomato , finely chopped  2 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , finely chopped  2 tablespoon Lemon juice  1 teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder  1 Green Chilli , finely chopped  1/4 cup Sev
instructions: To begin making the Homemade Canape Papdi Chaat Recipe, we will first make the canape papdi. In a bowl sieve to gather besan, oats flour, wheat flour. Add red chili powder, salt, oil, cooking soda and mix until the flour turn to form crumble.Add water little by little to the canape papdi mixture until you get a soft and stiff dough. Cover the dough with damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.Once well rested, knead for a few minutes again. Pinch a small portion of the dough, roll it into a ball.Sprinkle wheat flour on a clean surface. Place the ball on the surface and roll it as thin as possible. Cut out smaller round shapes and place them over a greased tart pans pressing them to the edges. Scrap out the extra dough from the edges of the tart pans. Repeat this step for rest of the dough.Preheat the oven at 150 degree centigrade. Place the tart pans in oven and bake the canape papdis until they start to turn golden brown. Remove from oven, let it cool for some time. Then gently pull the canapes out of the tart pan.These canape papdi cups can be stored in airtight containers for about a week.To make canape papdi chaat, mix all the ingredients mentioned except sev under the list 'for making chaat' in a bowl. Check the salt and seasoning and adjust to suit your taste.When you are ready to serve, spoon in the chaat mixture into canape papdi cups. Sprinkle some sev over top and serve the Homemade Canape Papdi Chaat immediately. If you prefer you could add some yogurt, green chutney and sweet chutney to give it an added taste and flavor.Khubani Ka Meetha Recipe (A Rich Hyderabadi Nawabi Dessert)

name: Hariyali Pav Bhaji Recipe
description: We usually make the normal pav bhaji by using the vegetables and spicing it with Pav Bhaji Masala. Here, lets give a twist to the usual pav bhaji by adding some greens in it. Try this one and impress your friends and family with this healthier version.
ingredients_name: Pav buns, Oil, Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu), Cumin seeds (Jeera), Curry leaves, Asafoetida (hing), Green Chillies, Ginger Garlic Paste, Onion, Tomato, Potato (Aloo), Green peas (Matar), Bottle gourd (lauki), Spinach Leaves (Palak), Red Chilli powder, Turmeric powder (Haldi), Pav bhaji masala, Garam masala powder, Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint), Butter (Salted), Coriander (Dhania) Leaves
ingredients_quantity: Pav buns , as required Oil , as required  1 teaspoon Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu)  1/2 teaspoon Cumin seeds (Jeera)  5 Curry leaves  1/4 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing)  2 Green Chillies , finely chopped (adjustable)  1/2 tablespoon Ginger Garlic Paste  1 Onion , finely chopped  1 Tomato , finely chopped  1 Potato (Aloo) , boiled and mashed  1/2 cup Green peas (Matar) , boiled  1/2 Bottle gourd (lauki) , boiled and pureed  1/2 cup Spinach Leaves (Palak) , pureed  1 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  1 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  1 tablespoon Pav bhaji masala  1/4 teaspoon Garam masala powder  1-1/2 tablespoon Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint) Butter (Salted) , as required  2 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , finely chopped
instructions: To begin making the Hariyali Pav bhaji recipe, firstly heat oil in a wok/kadhai.Add the cumin seeds, mustard seeds, curry leaves, asafoetida and green chillies.Once it is done, add ginger garlic paste and cook for about 15 seconds. Next, add the onions and let it cook till they become soft and transparent.Now add the potatoes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. After 2 to 3 minutes, add tomatoes, cover the pan and cook for about 5 minutes.Now add the bottle gourd puree, mashed potato and green peas. Add some water and mash it using a masher.Let it cook for about 5 to 6 minutes. Add all the masalas including salt, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, garam masala and pav bhaji masala.Cook for about 5 minutes and then add the spinach puree and the coriander paste. Let it cook for about 10 to 12 minutes.The next step is to roast the buns. Heat a little butter on a flat pan, sprinkle some pav bhaji masala and chopped coriander leaves.Now but the pav from between and keep on the same pan and roast from both the sides.Once it is cooked properly, add butter on top and serve hot with pav bhaji buns. Serve Hariyali Pav Bhaji  with Masala Chaas for a perfect weekday meal.

name: Amritsari Dry Dal Recipe - Amritsari Sookhi Dal Recipe
description: Rich in protein, Amritsari dry dal recipe is a dal in which urad dal and black lentils are used. Urad dal also has high amounts of iron, calcium, magnesium, folic acid. This dal is made in every Punjabi house and green chillies are also used in it. This is a happy dal that you can make in your daily meal.
ingredients_name: Black urad dal (split), onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger, coriander, salt, red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder, oil, celery, cumin, asafetida, green coriander
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup black urad dal (split) 2 Onion, thin and straight cut 2 tomatoes, finely chop 3 green chillies, finely chop 1/2 inch ginger, tighten 1/2 cup green coriander, finely chop salt, 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder according to taste 1/2 small spoon powder 1/4 small funny tight -blowing powder 1/2 teaspoon celery 1/2 teaspoon cumin asafoetida, 1/4 cup green coriander for a pinch of garnish, finely chop
instructions: To make Amritsari dry dal recipe, first wash the urad dal 3 to 4 times and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Now heat oil in a pan. Add celery, cumin, asafoetida and cook till the cumin seeds are stretched. Now add green chillies, garlic, onion, salt and cook until the onion becomes soft. After the onion becomes soft, add tomatoes, red chili powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and cook until the tomatoes are soft. Now add urad dal and some water. Cover the pan and cook until the lentils are cooked. Add some water because it is a happy lentil. Close the gass, garnish with green coriander and serve. Serve the Amritsari dry dal recipe with Tawa Paratha and Bundi Raita for the day's dinner.

name: Golgappa Chaat Recipe
description: Golgappa Chaat is a famous street snack food in India. This recipe is a good snack for kitty parties, birthday parties and festivals like holi or just any other get-together you plan to host, as it can be easily prepared in large quantities, ingredients can be prepared in advance, just needs assembling at the time of serving.These homemade golgappas are crunchy and tangy. You can adjust spices as per your taste.
ingredients_name: Sooji (Semolina/ Rava), All Purpose Flour (Maida), Oil, Cumin Powder (Jeera), Red Chilli Powder, Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint), Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarinder) Leaves (Pudina), Potato (Aloo), Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas), Boondi, Curd (Dahi / Yogurt), Sugar
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Sooji (Semolina/ Rava)  1/2 cup All Purpose Flour (Maida) Oil , for making dough and deep frying  1/2 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera) , roasted  1/2 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  1/2 cup Green Chutney (Coriander & Mint) , to taste  1/2 cup Sweet Chutney (Date & Tamarind) , to taste  1 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , chopped  1 sprig Mint Leaves (Pudina) , chopped  1 Potato (Aloo) , boiled and peeled  1/2 cup Kala Chana (Brown Chickpeas) , sprouted and boiled (optional)  2 tablespoons Boondi  2 cups Curd (Dahi / Yogurt) Sugar , to taste
