name: Kadle Bele Chutney Pudi Recipe
description: Chutney Pudi or Podi's are quintessential condiment in a South Indian kitchen. These are generally had as condiments or accompaniments with south indian tiffin dishes like idli and dosa or even with steaming hot rice, sambar and a palya or poriyal. This recipe comes in handy when you want an accompaniment immediately and you are running out of ideas, since this recipe can be store for 2 weeks or more when kept in a dry and clean air tight container. Kadle Bele Chutney Pudi Recipe is a traditional Karnataka style Podi recipe made with Channa Dal. The addition of dry coconut, tamarind, jaggery and red chillies adds a zing to the podi and makes it spicy sweet. Serve the Kadle Bele Chutney Pudi Recipe along with Instant Oats Rava Idli Recipe and Restaurant Style Sambar Recipe for breakfast.
ingredients_name: Chana Dal (Bengal Gram Dal), White Urad Dal (SPLIT), Dry Coconut (Kopra), Byadagi Dried Chillies, Jaggery, Tamarind, Asafoetida (Hing), Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal)  1/2 cup White Urad Dal (Split)  1/2 cup Dry coconut (kopra) , grated or chopped  15 Byadagi Dried Chillies  3 teaspoons Jaggery , powdered  18 grams Tamarind , (small lemon sized)  1 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing) Salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making Kadle Bele Chutney Pudi Recipe, dry roast the chana dal in a kadai to a golden hue on medium heat and take it out in a plate.Likewise, dry roast the urad dal, desiccated coconut and red chillies separately and remove it in a plate.In the same pan, add the tamarind and roast until all its dampness evaporates and remove it in a plate.Now, add the chana dal, urad dal, tamarind, red chillies in a mixer grinder and make a course mix of the same.Add in the roasted desiccated coconut, jaggery powder, asafoetida, season with salt and pulse the podi a couple of times in the mixer grinder until all the ingredients are well mixed together.Take it out and store it in an air tight container for further use.Serve the Kadle Bele Chutney Pudi Recipe along with Instant Oats Rava Idli Recipe and Restaurant Style Sambar Recipe for breakfast.

name: Achari Aloo Recipe - Potato Achari (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Achari Aloo is a sour, spicy dry side dish in which boiled potatoes are cooked with Achari spices. This vegetable paratha, roti or curd can be served with rice. It is a very simple side dish that is ready in a short time.
ingredients_name: Potatoes, asafoetida, dry red chili, pickle, vinegar, sugar, oil
ingredients_quantity: 4 Potato 1/2 St. Teaspoon asafetida 1 teaspoon cumin 3 dry red chili 3 tablespar pickle 2 tablespoons vinegar 1/2 teaspoon sugar oil, according to use
instructions: To make Achari potato, first wash the potatoes and boil it till half. Remove its peel and cut it. Now heat the oil in a pan. Add potatoes to it and cook until it becomes a little brown. Remove the potatoes and keep it separately. Add asafoetida, cumin and dry red chili in this pan. After 15 seconds, add potatoes and pickle to it. Mix well. After mixing, add vinegar and let it cook for 2 to 3 minutes. After 3 minutes, add sugar, some water and cook for 1 minute. Serve hot. Serve Achari potatoes with garlic dal and phulka for dinner.

name: Huruli Kaalu Chutney Pudi Recipe (Horse Gram Chutney Podi)
description: Horse Gram is called Huruli Kalu in Kannada and Kollu in Tamil. Horse gram is a protein enriched lentil which has high amounts of iron and calcium making it beneficial for everyone. It is also known to reduce the fat and sodium content in our body making it a super food for reducing weight and loweing blod pressure. Huruli Kaalu Chutney Pudi Recipe is a spicy lentil powder mix, usually had as a condiment with idli's or dosa's. The horse gram is roasted along with red chillies, curry leaves, little tamarind, asafoetida and ground to a course mix. Once prepared, it stays fresh in an airtight container for a month.
ingredients_name: Horse Gram dal (Kollu/ Kulith), Byadagi Dried Chillies, Guntur Dried Chillies, Curry Leaves, Tamarind, Asafoetida (Hing), Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Horse Gram Dal (Kollu/ Kulith)  6 Byadagi Dried Chillies  6 Guntur Dried Chillies  10 sprig Curry leaves Tamarind , Small lemon size  1 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing) Salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making Huruli Kaalu Chutney Pudi Recipe, dry roast the horse gram on medium heat until it turns golden brown and starts releasing its aroma and keep aside.In the same pan roast the red chillies till it releases it aroma and keep aside.Next, dry roast the curry leaves and tamarind until the curry leaves turn crispy and keep aside.Once all the ingredients comes down to the room temperature, place all the ingredients in a mixer grinder along with asafoetida and salt. Grind it into a course mix.Store it in an airtight container until further use.Serve the Huruli Kaalu Chutney Pudi Recipe mixed with sesame oil or ghee as a condiment with your Home Made Soft Idlis or Ghee Dosa for breakfast.

name: Sandah Guri Recipe (Assamese Roasted Rice Flour Porridge)
description: Sandah Guri Recipe is an Assamese Roasted Rice Flour Porridge recipe where well roasted rice is coarsely powdered and mixed in milk topped with ghee and dry fruits. It is a wholesome and nutritious instant porridge recipe that can be made anytime if you have stored roasted rice flour. The roasted rice flour can be stored up to a month in an airtight container. Have Sandah Guri Recipe with a glass of milk or almond flavoured milk for breakfast or as an evening snack.
ingredients_name: Rice, Milk, Jaggery, Ghee, Sultana Raisins
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Rice , soaked for 2 hours  2 cups Milk , boiled, or Curd  3-1/2 tablespoons Jaggery , grated, or Sugar (adjust)  2 teaspoons Ghee , (adjust)  2 tablespoons Sultana Raisins , roasted in ghee
instructions: To prepare Sandah Guri Recipe (Assamese Roasted Rice Flour Porridge), wash and soak rice for a minimum of 2 hours. Drain water and spread the rice on a kitchen towel or clean cloth to soak the excess water.Change the kitchen towel and rub well till the moisture gets absorbed. Do this a couple of times till the rice is nicely dry. (doing less of this will increase the time taken to roast. You can also dry it under sun)Heat a nonstick kadai/shallow frying pan and dry roast rice over medium heat but stirring constantly.Roast till the rice is crisp and brownish in color. Keep aside to cool.In a grinder jar, add the roasted and cooled rice to grind to a coarse flour. Collect the flour in an airtight jar and keep in a cool dry place for later use. Take 2-3 tablespoons of flour in a bowl and add milk or well whisked curd and stir well. Add sugar or grated jaggery and again mix still it dissolves well. Add some ghee on top and garnish with some fried raisins. You can also drizzle some melted jaggery on top.Serve Sandah Guri Recipe (Assamese Roasted Rice Flour Porridge) warm or cold as per your choice, for breakfast with almond flavoured milk.

name: Sabsige Soppina Idli Recipe (Dill Leaves Idli)
description: Give your already healthy Idlis a healthier makeover. Idlis are one of the most loved breakfasts by almost everyone and extremely convenient on weekdays if you have the batter ready in your fridge. This healthy addition of greens makes it packed full of nutrients and these idlis a great to pack in tiffin boxes. You can serve Sabsige Soppina Idli for breakfast or even can make it for a light and delicious dinner.
ingredients_name: Idli Dosa Batter, Dill leaves, Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), Oil, Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu), Cumin seeds (Jeera), Asafoetida (hing), Curry leaves, Black pepper powder, Turmeric powder (Haldi), Dry ginger powder, Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Idli Dosa Batter  3/4 cup Dill leaves , finely chopped  2 tablespoons Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal) , soaked (for 1 hour) For the tadka 1 tablespoon Oil  1 teaspoon Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu)  1 teaspoon Cumin seeds (Jeera)  1/4 teaspoon Asafoetida (hing)  6 Curry leaves , torn  2 teaspoon Black pepper powder , crushed coarsely Turmeric powder (Haldi) , A pinch  1/2 teaspoon Dry ginger powder Salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making the Sabsige Soppina Idli recipe, firstly heat oil in a tadka pan. Add the mustard seeds, cumin seeds and let them crackle. follow it up with the remaining ingredients in the same order.Follow it up with the remaining ingredients in the same order.In a bowl, add the cleaned and chopped dill leaves into the ready to use idli batter along with the soaked channa dal and the prepared tadka. Mix thoroughly, pour them into idli plates and steam for 12-15Mix thoroughly, pour them into idli plates and steam for 12-15 minutes. Serve hot.Serve Sabsige Soppina Idli along with Mixed Vegetable Sambar and Tomato Onion Chutney for your healthy and scrumptious breakfast.

name: मटर मशरुम करी रेसिपी - Matar Mushroom Curry (Recipe In Hindi)
description: भारतीय व्यंजनों में स्वादिष्ट करी की एक बड़ी सूची है, मटर मशरूम करी भी उन व्यंजनों में से एक है जो प्याज, टमाटर और लहसुन की ग्रेवी में पकाई जाती है। यह मटर मशरूम ड्राई करी फुल्का या तवा परठा के साथ किसी भी व्यस्त सप्ताह के दिन या रात में परोसी जा सकती है.
ingredients_name: बटन मशरुम, हरे मटर, प्याज, टमाटर, अदरक लहसुन का पेस्ट , जीरा, हल्दी पाउडर, धनिया पाउडर , लाल मिर्च पाउडर , गरम मसाला पाउडर , कसूरी मेथी, टमाटर केचप, क्रीम, तेल, हरा धनिया, नमक
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 कप बटन मशरुम , काट ले  2 कप हरे मटर , उबाल ले  1 प्याज , बारीक काट ले  2 टमाटर , प्यूरी बना ले  2 छोटा चमच्च अदरक लहसुन का पेस्ट   1/4 छोटा चमच्च जीरा  1/4 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च धनिया पाउडर   1/2 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर   1/4 छोटा चमच्च गरम मसाला पाउडर   1/2 छोटा चमच्च कसूरी मेथी  1/2 छोटा चमच्च टमाटर केचप , या शक्कर  2 बड़े चमच्च क्रीम तेल , प्रयोग अनुसार  1 बड़ा चमच्च हरा धनिया , काट ले (गार्निश के लिए) नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: मटर मशरुम करी को बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम कर ले. इसमें जीरा डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. 10 सेकण्ड्स के बाद इसमें कटे हुए प्याज डाले और भूरा होने तक पकने दे. भूरा होने के बाद इसमें अदरक लहसुन का पेस्ट डाले। 3 मिनट तक पकने दे. 3 मिनट बाद इसमें टमाटर प्यूरी डाले और 2 मिनट के लिए पकाए। 2 मिनट बाद सारे मसाले डाले और 3 से 5 मिनट के लिए पकने दे. 5 मिनट बाद इसमें मटर, मशरुम डाले और मिला ले. 5 से 6 मिनट के लिए पकने दे. इसके बाद इसमें कसूरी मेथी डाले और मिला ले. 1 मिनट बाद इसमें क्रीम डाले, 1 और मिनट केलिए पकाए और गैस बंद कर ले. हरे धनिये से गार्निश करें और गरमा गरम परोसे। मटर मशरुम करी को बूंदी रायता और भाकरी के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Bharwa Karela Masala Recipe - Bharwa Karela Masala (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Bharwa Bitter Masala is a tasty vegetable that you can make for your day or dinner. Bharwa bitter gourd is a happy vegetable, so serve it with lentils or kadhi. Bitter gourd is known for its health benefits, so serve it to your children. Molasses is used in this vegetable which reduces bitter gourd bitterness in this vegetable.
ingredients_name: Bitter gourd, salt, peanuts, coconut, garlic, cumin, jaggery, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, tamarind paste, salt, oil
ingredients_quantity: 2 bitter gourd 1/2 teaspoon salt, other ingredients according to taste 1/2 cup peanuts 1/2 cup coconut, tight 6 bud garlic 2 teaspoons cumin 2 teaspoon jaggery
instructions: To make the stuffed bitter gourd masala, wash the bitter gourd and make an incision with a knife and remove the seeds inside. Cut them 2 inches long, add salt and keep separate for 10 minutes. You will see that the vegetable must have released some water. Squeeze excess water and wash them completely. By doing this, bitterness will be reduced at one level in a saucepan, add water and boil it. Add bitter gourd to boiled water and cook it till it becomes soft. Avoid overcoming, as their size needs to be maintained. Remove the bitter gourd and allow it to cool enough to cool. Take the mugfly in a pan till it turns brown. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and after 15 seconds add garlic to it. Cook until garlic becomes brown. Now add half of the peanuts, coconut, garlic, cumin, jaggery, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder and salt in a mixer. Grind this mixture. Do not use water. Add a teaspoon of oil to this mixture and mix. Fill half the mixture inside Karlo and keep half for gravy. Now add remaining oil to a pan. Add filled bitter gourd to it and cook till they turn brown. Put some oil in another pan. After the oil is hot, add the remaining spices and let it cook for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes add 1 cup of water and cook until the gravy thickens. After the gravy thickens, add tamarind paste, mix and cover the pan. Add salt and let it cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Turn off the gas after 2 minutes and serve. Serve the filling bitter gourd masala with Gujarati Kadhi, Phulka and Rice for dinner.

name: Foxtail Millet Nucchina Unde Recipe (Foxtail Millet and Lentil Dumplings)
description: A healthy twist to the traditional nucchina unde, this foxtail millet and lentil dumpling is a great option for an evening snack or as a healthy starter.
ingredients_name: Foxtail Millet, Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal), Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), Yellow Moong Dal (Split), Fresh coconut, Green Chillies, Asafoetida (hing), Onion, Coriander (Dhania) Leaves, Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Foxtail Millet  3/4 cup Arhar dal (Split Toor Dal)  1/4 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal)  1 tablespoon Yellow Moong Dal (Split)  1/2 cup Fresh coconut , Grated  6 Green Chillies Asafoetida (hing) , a generous pinch  2 Onion , finely chopped  1 cup Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , finely chopped Salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making the Foxtail Millet Nucchina Unde recipe, wash and soak foxtail millet in a bowl for 6 to 8 hours.Wash the toor dal, chana dal, moong dal and soak it for 3 hours. Drain the water and mix the lentils and millet. Mix the other ingredients along with them except onion and grind it to a coarse mixture.Add salt, onion and quickly mix it with the coarse mixture. Grease the idli plates with ghee. Make lemon sized balls out of the coarse mixture and flatten it to resemble a malai chum chum.Steam them for 15-20 minutes until they are done. Serve Foxtail Millet Nucchina Unde along with Masala Chai for a healthy evening snack.

name: Celery tomato lady finger recipe - Ajwaini Tamatar Bhindi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Celery tomato lady finger is a delicious version of lady finger that is cooked in a flavored gravy from celery and can be served for your special guests in afternoon or dinner.
ingredients_name: Okra, celery, asafetida, red chili powder, tomato puree, sugar, cashew, salt
ingredients_quantity: 500 grams lady finger 2 teaspoon celery 1/4 teaspoon asafoetida 1 teaspoon red chilli powder 1 cup tomato puree 1 teaspoon sugar 2 tablesm spoonful
instructions: To make celery tomato lady finger, first cut the lady finger. Now heat the oil in a pan. Add ladyfingers to it and let it cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Push the pan and cook until the lady finger is cooked. After the lady finger is cooked, take it out of the gas and keep it separately. Heat some more oil in the same pan. Add celery and asafoetida to it. After 30 seconds, add tomato puree and red chili powder to it. Allow to cook from 3 to 5 Manute. After that add sugar, salt and let it cook for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, add cashew paste and mix. Allow this mixture to cook for 5 minutes and serve hot. Serve celery tomato lady finger with spinach raita, garlic dal and phulka for day dinner.

name: Amritsari dal recipe
description: Amritsari Dal recipe is an authentic winter food among the people of Punjab. The Dal is made with a blend of Black Urad Dal and Channa Dal which is cooked in a pressure cooker. Then the dal is tempered with onions, ginger, garlic and flavoured with authentic spices.
ingredients_name: Black Urad Dal (Whole), Chana Dal (Bengal Gram Dal), Onion, Tomato, Green Chillies, Ginger, Garlic, Ajwain (Carom Seeds), Red Chilli Powder, Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini)
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup Black Urad Dal (Whole)  1/4 cup Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal)  1 Onion , finely chopped  1 Tomato , finely chopped  2 Green Chillies , finely chopped  1 inch Ginger , grated  2 cloves Garlic , finely chopped  1/2 teaspoon Ajwain (Carom seeds)  1/4 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  1/2 teaspoon Garam masala powder  1 inch Cinnamon Stick (Dalchini) Salt , to taste Oil , as required
instructions: We will begin making the Amritsari Dal Recipe by rinsing and soaking the dals for at least 4 to 5 hours or overnight.Heat a teaspoon of oil into the pressure cooker, add the soaked dal along with half of the chopped tomatoes, 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder, 3 cups of water and salt to taste. Cover the cooker and pressure cook, until the dal is done.Once the dal is cooked through for atleast 4 to 5 whistles, turn off the heat and allow the pressure to release naturally.The next step is to make the masala for the dal. Into a heavy bottomed pan, heat a bit of oil. Once the oil is hot, add the onions, ginger, garlic and saute for a few minutes until the onions are tender.Add the chillies, tomatoes and the remaining masalas and saute well until the masalas are well combined into the tomatoes.Add the cooked dal and stir well into the masala. Adjust the consistency of the dal, by adding little water if required. Lightly mash the dal with the back of the spoon to give it a mushy texture. Cover and simmer the dal for about 10 minutes.Once done, stir in the chopped coriander leaves and serve.Serve the Amritsari Dal with Ajwain Puri,and Dubki Wale Aloo Recipe for a lunch meal.

name: Radish vegetable recipe - Mooli Ki Sabzi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Radish vegetable is a simple and quick dish that is perfect for the days of the week. It looks good both hot and cold. This is a good option for lunch box. Radish is very healthy due to its high water content and fiber. It also gives an option to use vegetables.
ingredients_name: Radish, radish leaves, oil, rye, curry leaves, dry red chili, tamarind paste, red chili powder, salt, coconut
ingredients_quantity: 3 radish 1 cup radish leaves, cut 1 tablespoon oil 1 teaspoon mustard seeds 2 kadhi leaf 2 dry red chilli 1 tablesmoon tamarind paste 2 teaspoons red chili powder salt, 2 tablespoons coconut according to taste, tighten coconut
instructions: To make radish vegetables, first heat the oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let it cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, add curry leaves and dry red chili. After 30 seconds, add chopped radish leaves. Mix and let it cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute, add chopped radish and cook on high flame. After 2 minutes, add salt, red chili powder, tamarind paste and mix. Reduce the heat and cook until the radish is cooked.  After cooking, garnish it with coconut and serve hot. Serve the radish vegetable with garlic dal and phulka for dinner.

name: Punjabi style Arabic vegetable recipe - Punjabi Style Arbi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Many people from North India believe that this Punjabi style is a favorite way of eating spicy Arabic vegetable Arabic. This is an easy way to make. Crudi and spicy, you can serve this Arabic vegetable to eat your day. Easy to make, you can also serve this vegetable in your or your children's lunch box.
ingredients_name: Arabic, onion, green chillies, ghee, cumin, salt, red chili powder, garam masala powder, mangoes, turmeric powder, green coriander
ingredients_quantity: Cut 3 5 500 grams Arabic 1 onion, thin cut 3 green chill, straight 2 tbouses of ghee 1 tsp ghee salt, 1 tbsp red chili powder according to taste 1/4 tile 1/4 tb teons of gentle gardum powder.
instructions: To make Punjabi style Arabic vegetable, first wash Arabic. After washing, take out the peel out and cut out the thin tall. Now heat the oil in a pan and add cumin seeds to it. After 15 seconds, add green chillies to it and let it cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute add onion and cook until they become soft. Add Arabs to it and cook for 4 minutes. After 4 minutes, add all the dry spices to it. Do not add mango powder and garam masala at this time. Reduce the heat and cook until Arabic is cooked. Keep mixing in the middle. After the Arabic ripening, add mango powder and garam masala powder, mix and let it cook for 1 minute. Turn off the gas and serve hot. Punjabi style Arabic vegetables served with Panchmail Dal, Palak Raita and Phulka for dinner.

name: गुलाब गुलकंद फिरनी रेसिपी - Rose Gulkand Phirni (Recipe In Hindi)
description: फ़िरनी एक अद्भुत, विलक्षण, अमीर, मलाईदार, रेशमी पुडिंग है जो एक लोकप्रिय उत्सव वाली डिश है। गुलाब गुलदंड फ़िरनी एक मलाईदार मिठाई है जिसमे दूध, चीनी, गुलकंद का उपयोग किया जाता है। इस मिठाई का मुख्य तारा गुलाब और गुलकंद है जिसे फिरनी में सुगंध देने के लिए जोड़ा जाता है। आप भी रसोई घर में इस फिरली को बनाने की कोशिश कर सकते हैं और घर पर एक मनोरम मिठाई का आनंद उठा सकते हैं। सबसे अच्छा क्या है, इसे बनाना बहुत आसान है.
ingredients_name: दूध, चावल, कंडेन्स दूध, गुलाब के पत्ते, गुलकंद, शक्कर, गुलाब का पानी, इलाइची पाउडर , सौंफ पाउडर, गुलाब का पानी, पिस्ता, बादाम, काजू, गुलाब के पत्ते
ingredients_quantity: 2 लीटर दूध , फुल फैट  1/2 कप चावल , 30 मिनट के लिए पानी में भिगो दे  1-1/2 कप कंडेन्स दूध  4 बड़े चमच्च गुलाब के पत्ते , 4 चमच्च गरम दूध में भिगो दे  2 बड़े चमच्च गुलकंद  2 बड़े चमच्च शक्कर  2 बड़े चमच्च गुलाब का पानी , या रूह अफ़ज़ाह  1/2 छोटा चमच्च इलाइची पाउडर   1/2 छोटा चमच्च सौंफ पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च गुलाब का पानी गार्निश के लिए 12 पिस्ता , काट ले  12 बादाम , काट ले  12 काजू , काट ले गुलाब के पत्ते , सूखे (थोड़े)
instructions: गुलाब गुलकंद फिरनी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले भिगोए हुए चावल में से पानी निकाल ले। चावल को कोर्स मिश्रण में पीस ले. इसमें 1/4 कप पानी डाले, मिलाए और रख दे. अब एक सॉसपैन में दूध उबलने रख दे. दूध के उबलने के बाद, आंच को काम कर ले और इसमें पिसा हुआ चावल डाले।दूध के गाढ़ा होने तक मिलाते रहे और इस समय तक चावल भी पक जाने चाहिए। चावल के पक जाने के बाद इसमें बची हुई सामग्री डाले और 3 से 5 मिनट के लिए और पकने दे. गैस बंद करें और फिरनी को ठंडा होने के लिए रख दे.  इस पर नट्स और गुलाब की पत्तियां डाले और परोसे।   गुलाब गुलकंद फिरनी को रात या दन के खाने के बाद मीठे में परोसे।

name: Carrot semolina's firni recipe - Carrot Semolina Phirni (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Carrot semolina firni is an excellent dessert that is eaten after Ramadan meal. It is also prepared during other important festive occasions such as marriage. Most of the firni is prepared with rice and milk, but in this we have cooked carrots in milk. Semolina in firni makes a wonderful creamic texture that makes this firni even more tasty.
ingredients_name: Carrots, milk, sugar, semolina, cardamom powder, almonds, ghee, saffron
ingredients_quantity: 2 carrots, tighten 500 cup milk 5 tablespoons sugar 1/2 cup semolina 1/2 teaspoon cardamom powder 10 almonds, blend and peel (Silver layer) 2 tablespoons ghee 5 saffron, little
instructions: To make carrot semolina's firni, first heat 1 tablespoon ghee in a saucepan.  Add tight carrots to it and cook for 5 minutes.  Now heat milk in a saucepan and add sugar to it. Allow it to boil and after boiling, add carrots, cardamom powder, saffron and let it cook for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, add sugges and mix it so that it does not fall in it. After thick, turn off the gas and keep it separately. Now add the remaining ghee to a small pan. Add almonds to it and let it cook for 10 seconds. Add this tempering to the firni, mix and serve. Serve the fiery of a taste -rich carrot semolina in the sweet after eating.

name: Spicy Tandoori Paneer Open Puff Recipe
description: Spicy Tandoori Paneer Open Puff Recipe is a layered open puff pastry that is filled with a delicious paneer filling flavoured with tandoori masala. Puff pastry are traditionally originated in France, the dough is laminated with butter to form various layers so when they are baked we get to see the multiple layers of dough that creates the flaky texture.
ingredients_name: All Purpose Flour (Maida), Butter (Unsalted), Salt, Butter (Unsalted), Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese), Sweet corn, Onion, Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum), Tomato, Ginger Garlic Paste, Turmeric powder (Haldi), Red Chilli powder, Cumin powder (Jeera), Chaat Masala Powder, Lemon juice, Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt)
ingredients_quantity: For the dough 2 cups All Purpose Flour (Maida)  1 cup Butter (Unsalted) , at room temperature  1 teaspoon Salt For the butter filling 1 cup Butter (Unsalted) , hard For the filling 100 grams Paneer (Homemade Cottage Cheese) , crumbled  100 grams Sweet corn  1 Onion , sliced  1 Green Bell Pepper (Capsicum) , sliced  1 Tomato , chopped  1 teaspoon Ginger Garlic Paste  1/2 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi)  1 teaspoon Red Chilli powder  1 teaspoon Cumin powder (Jeera)  1 teaspoon Chaat Masala Powder  1 tablespoon Lemon juice  1 tablespoon Hung Curd (Greek Yogurt)
instructions: To begin making the Spicy Tandoori Paneer Open Puff Recipe by making the butter log first. Use the unsalted butter which hard and cut them into small cubes.Spread them on a cling film and wrap it in such a way the u can roll it flat. Using rolling pin roll the butter into a rectangular shape about 2 centimeter thick. Make sure u do this quickly otherwise the butter will melt quickly.Place the rolled butter in the cling film itself and keep it in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.In the meanwhile make the dough, add all the ingredients in a mixing bowl. Using your hand create a crumble texture with the dough by mixing the flour and butter together.Slowly add water and knead it into a soft dough, keep it in the refrigerator for 10 minutes. Once done take out the dough and start rolling it into a rectangular shape so you can wrap the rectangular butter log with this dough.Once it is rolled, take out the butter and place it in the center, fold in and wrap the butter inside make sure you seal all openings by just pinching the dough.After sealing, gently roll the dough keeping the rectangular shape intact. Keep dusting flour on the dough and rolling it so that it does not stick. Keep edges straight and even. Don’t overwork the dough.Roll it into a long rectangular shape about 20 cm length  to 10 cm  breadth, keep the long length facing towards you, fold the left side to the middle and the right side as well, so that the two edges meet the center.Now fold it like a book and dust some more flour and refrigerate by covering it with a cling film for 10 minutes.Repeat the process around 5 times, make sure you refrigerate the dough every time you do the book folding.Keep the edges straight and do not over work it.In the meanwhile, pre-heat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius and keep it ready for baking.

name: Spinach and Dill Tart With Roasted Peppers Recipe
description: Spinach and Dill Tart With Roasted Peppers Recipe is delicious savoury mini tart that can be had as appetizers or even as a snack. The recipe consist of a pie crust filled with assorted bell peppers and spinach leaves. The dill leaves added to the vegetables compliments really well and brings out the freshness from the tart.
ingredients_name: Red Bell pepper (Capsicum), Garlic, Spinach, Dill leaves, Britannia Cheese Spread - Roasted Garlic, All Purpose Flour (Maida), Salt, Sugar, Butter (Unsalted), Chilled water
ingredients_quantity: For the filling 2 Red Bell pepper (Capsicum) , finely chopped  4 cloves Garlic , finely chopped  300 grams Spinach , finely chopped  100 grams Dill leaves , finely chopped  1 cup Britannia Cheese Spread - Roasted Garlic For Pie Crust 1-1/2 cups All Purpose Flour (Maida) ,  ( makes 40 mini tarts)  1/2 teaspoon Salt  1 tablespoon Sugar  1/2 cup Butter (Unsalted) , cut into small pea size pieces  3 to 4 tablespoons Chilled water
instructions: To begin making the Spinach and Dill Tart With Roasted Peppers Recipe, preheat the oven to 170 degree celsius. Pre make the pastry crust according to instructions.Roll the pastry dough into small circles and place it in the mini tart shell cups. Bake mini tart shells in the pre heated oven for 12 to 15 minutes until crisp and golden. Keep it aside to cool as you move on to make the filling.Heat a sauce pan with oil, add garlic and saute until they soften. Add bell peppers and saute until they become soft.Add chopped spinach and dill leaves and give it a saute. Evaporate all the water from the spinach leaves. Turn off the heat and allow it to cool down.Mix the sauteed vegetables along with garlic cheese spread and the filling for the tart is ready.Fill a heap tablespoon of the filling into the mini tart shells and serve.Serve the Spinach and Dill Tart along with Ahina Long Leaf Green Tea for an afternoon snack or a tea party with friends and family.

name: Odia Chatu Besara Recipe (Mushrooms in Spicy Mustard Curry)
description: Odia Chatu Besara Recipe (Mushrooms in Spicy Mustard Curry) Mushrooms cooked in spicy mustard based sauce is a specialty of the eastern state of Odisha. 'Besara' is the Oriya used term for gravies made out of a thick base of the traditional mustard sauce. This dish uses minimal ingredients and is very quick to prepare. A comforting, flavourful curry, Odia Chatu Besara Recipe is best served with some hot dinner.
ingredients_name: Button mushrooms, Potato (Aloo), Oil, Tomatoes, Turmeric powder (Haldi), Salt, Coriander (Dhania) Leaves, Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu), Cumin seeds (Jeera), Coriander (Dhania) Seeds, Dry Red Chillies
ingredients_quantity: 400 grams Button mushrooms  1 Potato (Aloo)  1 tablespoon Oil  2 Tomatoes  1/2 teaspoon Turmeric powder (Haldi) Salt , to taste Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , as required, for garnishing Ingredients for the mustard paste 1-1/2 tablespoons Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu)  1 teaspoon Cumin seeds (Jeera)  5 teaspoons Coriander (Dhania) Seeds  5 Dry Red Chillies
instructions: To begin making the Chatu Besara Recipe first clean the mushrooms thoroughly under running water. Cut them into halves and keep aside.Peel the potato and chop it into small pieces and keep it in a bowl of water until it is needed. Setting chopped potatoes aside in water helps retain their colour.Next, prepare the mustard paste. Place all the ingredients listed under “for mustard paste” into a blender and grind to a fine but thick paste. Add as little water as possible in order to ensure that the paste is thick and not runny.Now, to begin making the curry, add about 2 tablespoons of oil into a kadai or a heavy bottomed pan on a medium heat.First add the potatoes, sprinkle some salt and saute until they are almost cooked and get a light brown colour. Once the potatoes are cooked, transfer them to a paper towel to drain the excess oil and keep aside.In the same kadai, add the chopped tomatoes and toss them for a minute. Next, add the chopped mushrooms. Saute these on high heat for 6-8 minutes, until the mushrooms are half cooked. Add the roasted potatoes and turmeric powder and toss together for another couple of minutes.To this, add the prepared mustard paste, mix well and saute for 2 more minutes. Add salt and required amount of water of the gravy, as per the consistency you desire. Allow the curry to come to a boil so the masalas get cooked thoroughly. Simmer the Odia Chatu Besara on low to medium heat for about 5 minutes, until all the masalas get well absorbed by the vegetables.Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve the Odia Chatu Besara along with dinner.

name: Orya Kakharu Phula Bhaja Recipe (Pumpkin Flower Fritters)
description: Oriya Kakharu Phula Bhaja or Pumpkin Flower Fritters Recipe is a popular Odissi fritter recipe which is also famous in West Bengal. These pumpkin flower fritters is an easy and quick recipe. To use in this recipe, only male flowers that are harvested from the pumpkin plant are used to cook. This is since the female flowers of pumpkin will grow to be the edible pumpkins. These Odiya Kakharu Phula Bhaja Recipe (Pumpkin Flower Fritters) are served as an accompaniment with rice and Oriya Style Moong Dalma Recipe or can be served with Masala Chai during evenings.
ingredients_name: Pumpkin flowers, Rice, Dry Red Chilli, Garlic, Green Chilli, Chaat Masala Powder, Cumin seeds (Jeera), Turmeric powder (Haldi), Mustard oil, Salt, Water
ingredients_quantity: 12 Pumpkin flowers  4 tablespoons Rice , soaked for at least 30-40 minutes  1 Dry Red Chilli  2 cloves Garlic  2 Green Chilli  3 pinch Chaat Masala Powder , (optional)  1/2 teaspoon Cumin seeds (Jeera)  1 pinch Turmeric powder (Haldi) Mustard oil , to shallow fry Salt , as needed Water , as needed
instructions: To prepare Oriya Kakharu Phula Bhaja Recipe (Pumpkin Flower Fritters), firstly soak the rice for 30-40 minutes.Meanwhile, cut out lower part/sepal (which contains a stalk, a bottom and at center a stigma (0.5-1 inch length and yellow in color) of the flower, except the petal.Clean the flowers individually under slow running water and pat dry on a paper napkin. Keep aside.Then grind the soaked rice, garlic, green chili, red chili, cumin seeds in a Blender and make a smooth batter of medium consistency; not very runny though. Add salt, a pinch of turmeric powder and mix well.Heat mustard oil in a nonstick pan/tawa on a medium flame.Now take one flower at a time, dip in batter, shake off excess batter and place on the tawa. Do this step for rest of the flowers.Cook for 2 minutes or till crisp on one side. Then flip and cook the other side by drizzling a little oil.Fry until both sides of the pumpkin flower is crisp.Serve Oriya Kakharu Phula Bhaja Recipe (Pumpkin Flower Fritters) hot with rice and Oriya Style Moong Dalma Recipe or can be sprinkled with chat masala and be served with Masala Chai during evenings.

name: Oriya Badi Chura Recipe | Sundried Lentil Dumpling Crumble
description: The badi chura is an authentic recipe of Odisha state. Badi is sun-dried lentil dumpling and chura means a coarse mixture of badi, onion, garlic, green chilli along with mustard oil. Nowadays there are varieties of badi available. But traditionally, soaked black gram or urad dal is grinded to a paste along with some water. Then these dumplings are sundried. Usually these are made in fall and stored away for entire year. Serve Badi Chura Recipe | Sundried Lentil Dumpling Crumble with pakhala (oriya term for overnight fermented cooked rice, usually mixed with curd) or as a snack.
ingredients_name: Badi (wadi), Onion, Garlic, Green Chilli, Mustard oil, Salt
ingredients_quantity: 14 Badi (wadi)  1 Onion , finely chopped  4 cloves Garlic  2 Green Chilli , (adjust)  2 teaspoons Mustard oil Salt , to taste
instructions: To prepare Badi Chura Recipe | Sundried Lentil Dumpling Crumble, prep all the ingredients required.Heat mustard oil in a pan. Shallow fry the badis till golden brown in color. Turn off the heat and allow to cool. Instead of shallow frying in oil, these badis can be roasted without oil too.Add chopped onion, garlic cloves, green chilies and fried badis in a blender jar and pulse for 1-2 minutes to make a coarse mixture. (But in ancient times, all the things are put in a mortar-pestle made of stone and then a coarse mixture is made out.)If the badis are just roasted without oil, then put mustard oil along with other things in the blender jar before blending.Serve this authentic Oriya Badi Chura Recipe | Sundried Lentil Dumpling Crumble immediately as a side dish with plain rice or pakhala (oriya term for overnight fermented cooked rice, usually mixed with curd) or as a snack.

name: Mirchi Dakodi Recipe - Mirchi Pakodi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Mirchi dumplings are famous street chaat. You can make it anytime. The party has the best starter and is perfect snacks in the season of Barish. Sour-sweet and spicy, this chaat is made of green chillies and gram flour, which is filled with tamarind stuffing.
ingredients_name: Green chillies, tamarind paste, jaggery, celery, fennel powder, gram flour, red chili powder, salt, gram flour, baking soda, turmeric powder, celery, water, onion, peanuts, green coriander, lemon juice, chaat masala powder
ingredients_quantity: 6 green chillies for stuffing, 2 tablespoons of tamarind tamarind paste 2 tablespoons jaggery 1/4 teaspoon celery 1/4 teaspoon fennel powder 3 tablespoon gram flour, roasted 1/4 teaspoon red chili powder salt, 1-1/2 cup for taste, 1/2 cup for taste, 1/2 teaspoon of gram flour Pinch water, other ingredients as per requirement, (finely cut) peanuts as per requirement, green coriander as per requirement, (finely cut) Lemon juice as per requirement, chaat masala powder as per need, as per need
instructions: Mix tamarind paste and good. Mix this kind of stuffing and remove the seeds by mixing the poinch in the middle. Mix tamarind good paste, and all the stuffing things and fill it in green chillies. Mix all the things of gram flour in the second bowl and prepare the downturn. Fry brown and crispy on the heat. Fry all the chilies and take it in a plate, cut it into pieces and take a little oil in the pen and fry it in a served plate and sprinkle onion, spicy peanuts, coriander, lemon juice, and chaat masala and serve immediately. Serve chilli dumplings with masala tea during evening tea.

name: Dum Arabic Vegetable Recipe - Dum Arbi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Arabic is good for health. Dietary fiber and carbohydrates in Arabic are considerable amounts. Vitamins and minerals are also rich. This spicy power is made with Arabic Dum. Rich in spices and taste, this power has been cooked in the gravy of Arabic Dahi.
ingredients_name: Arabic, oil, oil, tomato, green chillies, ginger garlic paste, onion, curd, asafetida, celery, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, garam masala powder, salt, green coriander
ingredients_quantity: 300 grams of Arabic, boiling 2 tablespoons of tukde hai 2 tablespoons oil, 2 tablespoons to fry, 1/2 cup tomatoes for vegetable, finely chopped 1 tablespoon green chili, finely bitter 2 teaspoon ginger garlic paste 1/4 cup 1/4 cup onion, finely cut 1/2 cup, 1/2 cup curry asafoetida, 1/2 celery 1/2 celery 1/2 celery 1 teaspooning coriander powder 1 teaspoon red chili powder 1/4 teaspoon garam masala salt, 2 tablespoons green coriander as per taste
instructions: To make Dum Arabic vegetable, first whisk the right and keep it on the side. Take oil in a pen and fry the pieces of Arabic till they turn golden brown. Heat the oil to make vegetables in the pan. Apply celery and asafetida. Add ginger and garlic paste and mix. Add red chilli powder, coriander powder, turmeric powder and mix. Add onion and green chilli. After the onion is soft, add tomatoes and cook until the tomato becomes soft and the oil starts appearing above. Now add Arabic and mix. Putting 1/2 cup of water and not getting out, in this way, cover the lid and cook the vegetable on low flame for 10 minutes. Serve hot by mixing green coriander. Serve the Arabic vegetable with Tawa Paratha and Bundi Raita for the day's dinner.

name: Tomato Pumpkin Seeds Deep Recipe - Tomato Pumpkin Seeds Dip
description: Pumpkin seeds are a super food. In which zinc, phosphorus, Aryan, minerals and antiocycidons are available in plenty of omega-3. This healthy deep you can serve with snacks such as dances, cracks and carrots and radishes.
ingredients_name: Pumpkin seeds, tomatoes, garlic, red chilli palax, extra virgin olive oil, green coriander, salt
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup pumpkin seeds, (pumpkin seeds) 1/2 cup tomato 2 bud garlic 1 teaspoon red chilli palax 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1/4 cup green coriander salt, as per taste
instructions: To make tomato pumpkin seeds deep, first fry the pumpkin seeds on medium flame till the fragrance on the pen. And take out in the bowl. Take 1 big teaspoon of olive oil in the same pen and add tomatoes, chili flakes and salt to it and cook it till it becomes soft and cool down. Mix tomatoes, seeds, garlic, green coriander and prepare a smooth paste. Serve tomato pumpkin seeds deep with crackers during tea.

name: Sabza Shikanji Recipe - Chia Seeds Shikanji (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Sabza Shikanji is the most healthy drink. This drink gives freshness and cool to the body during summer days. The Sabza Shikanji Sabza is made of seed and lemon.
ingredients_name: Sabza seeds, cold water, ice, lemon, sugar, black salt or rock salt, cumin powder, pepper powder, mint
ingredients_quantity: 4 teaspoons sabza seed 3 cup cold water 1 cup ice 3 lemon, ras out 4 tablespoons sugar, powdered black salt or rock salt, cumin powder as per taste, pinch of pepper powder, a pinch of mint, garnish
instructions: To make Sabza Shikanji, first soak the Sabza seed in 2 cups of water for 30 minutes. In the world, add 3 cups of water, sugar, lemon juice, black pepper, black pepper powder, and mix it until the sugar dissolves. Serve immediately by putting it in glass. Serve Sabza Shikanji during summer. You can also add honey to taste instead of sugar.

name: Roasted Pumpkin, Orange and Urad Dal Salad Recipe
description: Roasted Pumpkin, Orange and Urad Dal Salad Recipe is a very earthy salad made from steamed urad dal and mixed along with oven roasted pumpkin. The ingredients are tossed in with a refreshing citrus orange dressing. Right amount of salt and pepper is added to help in balancing the salad as a whole.
ingredients_name: White Urad Dal (Split), Kaddu (Parangikai/ Pumpkin), Orange, Coriander (Dhania) Leaves, Fresh orange juice, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Salt and Pepper
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup White Urad Dal (Split)  150 grams Kaddu (Parangikai/ Pumpkin) , thinly sliced  1 Orange , skin peeled and segments removed  3 sprig Coriander (Dhania) Leaves For the dressing 1/2 Fresh orange juice  4 tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil Salt and Pepper , to taste
instructions: To begin making the Roasted Pumpkin, Orange and Urad Dal Salad Recipe, we will first pressure cook the dal with 1 cup water and salt to two whistle and switch it off.Once done allow the pressure to release naturally and drain the dal and keep it aside.Pre heat the oven to 180 degree Celsius to 10 minutes. Keep your pumpkin slices lined over a baking tray and drizzle some oil, salt and pepper and bake it for at least 20 minutes.Once the pumpkin become soft and lightly crisp add it into a mixing bowl. Add dal, orange segments in to the same bowl.In a small bowl, whisk in all the ingredients together until it emulsifies and pour it over the salad and toss it well.Serve it on to a plate and garnish with some coriander leaves.

name: Dal Palak Recipe - Dal Palak (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Lentils spinach recipe is a very tasty and nutritious dish.  Lentil spinach has high amount of protein and minerals, as it uses boiled spinach.  This recipe contains a temper of ghee which increases the taste of dal spinach recipe even more.
ingredients_name: Pili moong dal, lentils, spinach, tomato, ginger, turmeric powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, salt, ghee, cumin, dry red chili
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup Pili Moong Dal 1/2 Cup Masoor Dal 250 grams spinach, finely cut and boiled 1 tomato, finely chopped 1 inch ginger, anecdote 1 teaspoon of turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder 1/2 teaspoon spoonful
instructions: To make lentils spinach recipe, first cook the dal in a pressure cooker with 3 cups of water. See here to know the method of cooking the lentils in the pressure cooker.   You can also cook spinach in a pressure cooker or fry slightly in a little oil in a pan.  Now the spinach has been given the method of cooking in the pressure cooker, but if you are cooking in a pan, then the same method should cook the spinach till it becomes soft and soft. Now heat the oil in the pressure cooker. After 10 seconds, add ginger, green chillies, tomatoes, turmeric powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, salt and spinach and cook till a city comes.   On the city, turn off the gas and keep the cooker under cold water.  So that the pressure of the cooker comes out and the spinach does not cook too much and beat.  Now that both lentils and spinach are ready, now mix cooked dal in cooked spinach and stir.  Now let the lentils boil the spinach.  Now prepare for the tempering, heat a tablespoon of ghee in the tempering pan for the tempering, add cumin seeds and add dry red chili and fry it well.  Add this tempering to the lentils and mix it well and serve hot. You can also use lentils to make lentils, lentils and moong, tur or chana dal.  Serve the lentil spinach with hot hot tava paratha, spinach raita and kachumbar salad in winter.

name: Vegetable Rawa Idli Recipe - Veggie Rava Idli (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Vegetable Rava Idli is a very easy recipe. It is delicious as well as good for your health. Apart from breakfast, you can also serve this idli on the time of tea.
ingredients_name: Semolina, curd, ginger, sweet corn, green peas, carrots, green coriander, green chillies, ray, chana dal, kadhi leaves, red chilli palax, oil, salt, ino fruit salt, water
ingredients_quantity: 1-1/2 cup semolina 1 cup yogurt 1 ginger, grated 1/2 cup sweet corn 1/2 cup green peas 1/2 cup 1/2 cup carrot, grated 1/2 cup green coriander, finely chopped 4 green chillies, finely chopped 1 tablespoon ray 1/2 tablespoon gram gram 10 leaves 10 kadhi leaves Cup water
instructions: To make vegetable rava idli, first of all mix semolina, curd and water in a large bowl. Mix it well. After this, add corn, carrots, peas, ginger, green coriander and salt. Mix everyone and keep it aside. Now heat the oil in a small pan. When it becomes a little hot, add rye, gram dal, curry leaves and chili flakes. Keep it aside for a few seconds. Now mix this tempering in semolina and mix it well. Before sending thedli, add fruit salt and mix it. Now apply some oil on the idli steamer and fill it with a mixture of idli. Steam it for at least 12 to 15 minutes and serve hot.

name: Dahi Bhindi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Curd ladyfinger is a very easy and delicious recipe.  To make it, curd is mixed with gram flour and spices and cooked with roasted ladyfingers.  By adding roasted onions, the taste of this gravy vegetable increases even more.
ingredients_name: Lady (Okhara), onion, ginger, yogurt, gram flour, garam masala powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, salt, onion, oil, ghee, cumin, dry cashmere chilli, green coriander
ingredients_quantity: 200 grams lady finger, 1 onion chopped in 1 inch pieces, finely chopped 1 inch ginger, kadukas 1 cup curd, ghada plan 2 tablespoon gram flour 1 teaspooning garam masala powder 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon red spoon red chili powder, 1 cup of cup, 1 cup, 1 cup, cake, onion or causing onion Ingredients for the temper
instructions: To create a yogurt lady finger recipe, we will first roast or fry the lady finger.  For that, heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and put the chopped onion and ladyfinger in it. Add a little salt and cover it and let it cook on low flame.  When you cover and cook the ladyfinger, the ladyfinger releases some water and that water helps him cook. When the lady finger is cooked and becomes soft, remove the lid and cook on low flame for a while. The lady finger should be cooked so that the chip should be chip and becomes light brown. When this happens, add some oil and oil and sprinkle gram flour and slowly mix well. By doing this, the chip chip of lady finger will be removed. Now keep the cooked lady finger aside and make curd gravy. To make curd gravy, first take curd in a bowl, gram flour, kadukas ginger, garam masala powder, turmeric, red chili and whisk it well.  Now add 1/2 cup of water and move it. Now put that curd mixture in the pan and let it cook on low heat and bring boiled. But keep shaking the curd with a light hand so that the curd is not torn and cooked well.  Let it cook until the curd becomes creamy.  When cooked well, mix the roasted ladyfinger. And let it cook for some time. Taste the taste of other spices and make it equal to your own.  Now turn off the gas and put it in a pot. Now prepare for the early morning.  Heat 1 tablespoon ghee in a tempering pan. Now add cumin, dry red chili. Now put this tempering and the caramiced onion on the curd ladyfinger. Mix a little bit and decorate it with green coriander. The curd lady finger can be served with hot hot and kachumbar salad.

name: Roasted Tomato And Mozzarella Caprese Salad With Basil Balsamic Vinegar Recipe
description: Caprese is a word refers anything that imitates the style of an Italian island, Capri close to Naples. Italians are passionate for using tomatoes and all kind of cheese in their meals.This recipe is an absolute example, since their breakfast too is totally inspired similar with these ingredients with blended special herbs and vinegar for ultimate health and protein balance.Try this traditional Italian salad recipe at home, you will be amazed how easy it is to make and believe, taste rules till the end.
ingredients_name: Tomatoes, Mozzarella cheese, Basil leaves, Rosemary, Garlic, Lemon juice, Black pepper powder, Paprika powder, Balsamic Vinegar, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Sea salt
ingredients_quantity: 6 Tomatoes  100 grams Mozzarella cheese  10 Basil leaves , chopped  1 sprig Rosemary  5 cloves Garlic  1/2 teaspoon Lemon juice  1/2 teaspoon Black pepper powder  1 teaspoon Paprika powder  2 Tablespoon Balsamic Vinegar  2 teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil Sea salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making the Roasted Tomato And Mozzarella Caprese Salad With Basil Balsamic Vinegar recipe, at the very beginning marinate the tomato halves in 1/2 teaspoon of oil, salt, pepper, paprika, brown sugar, basil and lemon juice for 10 minutes.Cut the cheese into 5 thick slices. Meanwhile heat oil in a roasted pan and add garlic, fry for a minute.Arrange the tomatoes in circles on the pan, insert cheese slices in between tomatoes with gaps, lay the rosemary sprig on top.Drizzle balsamic vinegar. Cook till the cheese melts and tomatoes are done for about 8 minutes approximately.Check for salt and pepper seasoning. Serve hot on plate.Serve Roasted Tomato And Mozzarella Caprese Salad With Basil Balsamic Vinegar along with French Onion Soup for weekday dinner.

name: Savory Bread Pudding with Broccoli and Tomato Recipe
description: Savory Bread Pudding with Broccoli and Tomato Recipe, is a twist to the sweet pudding that we are familiar with. At Archana’s kitchen we always try to make it healthy and different by adding a slight variation to the usually cooking process. In this recipe we have added pumpkin and broccoli to the bread pudding to give a savory touch. The pudding is made with a one day old whole wheat baguette which chopped into small pieces and layered onto a baking tray with pumpkin and broccoli. The whole bread mixture is then soaked with egg and milk.
ingredients_name: Kaddu (Parangikai/ Pumpkin), Broccoli, Onion, Garlic, Rosemary, Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini), Salt, Baguette, Milk, Tomato, Whole Egg, Milk, Vanilla Extract, Honey
ingredients_quantity: 150 grams Kaddu (Parangikai/ Pumpkin) , skin peeled and cubed  1 cup Broccoli , chopped into medium florets  1 Onion , sliced  2 cloves Garlic , chopped  1 teaspoon Rosemary  1/2 teaspoon Cinnamon Powder (Dalchini) Salt , to taste  1/2 Baguette , whole wheat, cut into small cubes  1/4 cup Milk  1 Tomato , sliced For the custard 1 Whole Egg  1 cup Milk  1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract  2 tablespoons Honey
instructions: To begin making the Savory Bread Pudding with Broccoli and Tomato Recipe, pressure cook the pumpkin with water for about 3 whistle. Keep it aside until the pressure is released naturally.Pre heat the oven to 180 degree Celsius to 10 minutes.Heat a sauce pan with oil, add onions and garlic sauté until it softens. Add broccoli and sauté until the broccoli has the slight crunch.Add boiled pumpkin along with cinnamon powder, rosemary, salt and pepper. Give it a toss.Add milk and check for salt. Cook until the mixture thickens little.Take out a baking tray, layer half of the mixture first. Add half of the chopped baguette. Layer the rest of the mixture on top and add the remaining baguette.Whisk in the egg, milk, vanilla and honey together and pour it over.Add sliced tomatoes over the top and sprinkle with the rest of seasonings and bake it in the oven for 20 minutes. Serve the Bread Pudding with Broccoli and Tomato Recipe along with Plum Ginger Juice and Fresh Fruit Bowl to kick start your mornings.

name: Tangy Raw Beetroot & Tomato Chutney Recipe
description: Tangy Raw Beetroot & Tomato Chutney Recipe is delicious concoction which is full of health and nutrients. Beetroots, Beets or Chukandar as we know is low in fat and high in Vitamin C and insoluble fiber. The naturally occurring color adds a vibrancy to whatever you make with beetroot.
ingredients_name: Beetroot, Coriander (Dhania) Leaves, Tomato, Green Chillies, Lemon juice, Water, Salt
ingredients_quantity: 1/2 cup Beetroot , roughly chopped  1/2 cup Coriander (Dhania) Leaves , roughly Chopped  1/4 cup Tomato , roughly chopped  2 Green Chillies , chopped  1 tablespoon Lemon juice , (Or to taste) Water , as required Salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making Tangy Raw Beetroot & Tomato Chutney Recipe, get all the ingredients prepped and handy.In a food processor, add coarsely chopped raw beetroots, coriander, tomatoes, chillies, and pulse till they form a coarse mix.Add lemon juice, salt to taste, and blend again for about 20 seconds or till the desired consistency, with the help of a little water. Take out into the serving bowl. Adjust lemon and salt to taste.Serve Tangy Raw Beetroot & Tomato Chutney Recipe with Carrot Onion Uttapam Recipe, Paruppu Podi Recipe and South Indian Filter Coffee Recipe for breakfast on a weekday.

name: ओटमील डोसा रेसिपी - Savoury Oatmeal Breakfast Crepes (Recipe In Hindi)
description: ओटमील डोसा एक सुपर सरल और शीग्र बनने वाली रेसिपी है. ओट्स में गेहूं के आटा, हरी मिर्च, अदरक और हरा धनिया मिलाया जाता है. यह स्वादिष्ठ तो है ही, साथ में सेहत के लिए अच्छा भी है. जब घर में खाना बनाने की सामग्री कम पढ़ जाती है   तो यह हमेशा यह बनाया जाता है. मेरे बच्चे नाश्ते या रात के खाने के लिए या स्कूल के स्नैक में यह खाना पसंद करते है.
ingredients_name: ओटमील, गेहूं का आटा, सूजी, दही, पानी , हरी मिर्च, जीरा पाउडर , पूरी काली मिर्च, हरा धनिया, तेल, नमक
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप ओटमील  1 कप गेहूं का आटा  1/2 कप सूजी  1/2 कप दही  3 कप पानी   2 हरी मिर्च , बारीक काट ले  1 छोटा चमच्च जीरा पाउडर   1 बड़ा चमच्च पूरी काली मिर्च , क्रश कर ले  2 बड़े चमच्च हरा धनिया , काट ले तेल , प्रयोग अनुसार नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: ओटमेमल डोसा रेसिपी बनाने  के लिए, एक बड़े कटोरे में साड़ी सामग्री दाल दे, मिलाए और इसे लगभग 10 मिनट तक अलग से रख दे। 10 मिनट के बाद, अच्छी तरह से मिलाए और अपने हिसाब से उसकी कंसिस्टेंसी देख ले. एक तवे को माध्यम आंच पर गरम करें। इसमें तेल डाले और थोड़ा गरम होने दे. इसमें थोड़ा डोसा का मिश्रण डाले और चमच्च की मदद से गोल डोसा बना ले. डोसे के चारों किनारों पर तेल डाले और मध्यम आंच पर पकने दे. एक साइड से पकने के बाद उसे फ्लिप करें और पकने दे. पकने के बाद गरमा गरम परोसे। ओटमील डोसा को नारियल की चटनी और फ़िल्टर कॉफी के साथ नाश्ते के लिए परोसे।

name: ब्रोकली पनीर और मूंगफली मसाला रेसिपी - Broccoli Paneer And Peanut Masala (Recipe In Hindi)
description: हम सब जानते है की ब्रोकली को खाने से बहुत सारे फायदे होते है. ब्रोकली कैलोरी में काम होती है और उसमे जरुरी विटामिन, मिनरल्स और फाइबर होता है. पनीर सबको पसंद आता है और इसमें प्रोटीन की मात्रा अधिक होती है. मूंगफली को डालने से इस सब्ज़ी का स्वाद और भी बढ़ जाता है.
ingredients_name: ब्रोकली, पनीर, मूंगफली , हरी मिर्च, प्याज, टमाटर, जीरा, पूरी काली मिर्च, कश्मीरी लाल मिर्च पाउडर, गरम मसाला पाउडर , बिरयानी मसाला, हल्दी पाउडर, मक्खन, कसूरी मेथी, नमक
ingredients_quantity: 2 कप्स ब्रोकली , काट ले  1 कप पनीर , काट ले  1 कप मूंगफली   4 हरी मिर्च  4 प्याज , काट ले  4 टमाटर , काट ले  2 छोटा चमच्च जीरा  1 छोटा चमच्च पूरी काली मिर्च  1 छोटा चमच्च कश्मीरी लाल मिर्च पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च गरम मसाला पाउडर   1/2 छोटा चमच्च बिरयानी मसाला  1/4 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  2 छोटा चमच्च मक्खन  1 छोटा चमच्च कसूरी मेथी नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: ब्रोकली पनीर और मूंगफली मसाला बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें काली मिर्च और जीरा डाले। 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें प्याज और हरी मिर्च डाले। प्याज के थोड़ा भूरा होने तक पकाए। प्याज के भूरा होने के बाद इसमें मूंगफली डाले और 2 मिनट के लिए पकने दे. 2 मिनट के बाद, इसमें टमाटर डाले और मिला ले. टमाटर के नरम होने तक पकाए, गैस बंद करें और उसे ठंडा होने दे. ठंडा होने के बाद, इसे मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में डाले और पेस्ट बना ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें जीरा, लाल मिर्च पाउडर और हल्दी पाउडर डाले। 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें ब्रोकली डाले और 6 से 8 मिनट तक पकाए।8 मिनट के बाद इसमें पनीर, गरम मसाला और बिरयानी मसाला डाले। अच्छी तरह से मिलाए। 10 मिनट बाद, इसमें प्याज टमाटर का पेस्ट डाले और मिला ले.नमक, मक्खन डाले और 5 से 8 मिनट तक पकाए। 8 मिनट बाद इसमें कसूरी मेथी डाले और मिला ले. 3 मिनट के लिए पकने दे और फिर गैस बंद कर दे. ब्रोकली पनीर और मूंगफली मसाला को ग्रामा गरम परोसे।  ब्रोकली पनीर और मूंगफली मसाला को दाल तड़का, भिंडी रायता और रोटी के साथ गरमा गरम परोसे।

name: Beetroot Chutney Recipe
description: Beetroot Chutney is a healthy recipe which is very easy to make and can be eaten along idli, dosa or steamed rice. It just requires a few ingredients which are available in our kitchen on daily basis.
ingredients_name: Beetroot, Curry leaves, Green Chillies, Asafoetida (hing), Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal), White Urad Dal (Split), Fresh coconut, Water, Salt, Sesame (Gingelly) Oil, Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu), Curry leaves, Asafoetida (hing)
ingredients_quantity: 1 Beetroot , grated  1 sprig Curry leaves  2 Green Chillies  1 pinch Asafoetida (hing)  1/2 tablespoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil  1 tablespoon Chana dal (Bengal Gram Dal)  1 tablespoon White Urad Dal (Split)  1/3 cup Fresh coconut , grated  1/2 cup Water Salt , to taste For tempering 1 tablespoon Sesame (Gingelly) Oil  1/2 tablespoon Mustard seeds (Rai/ Kadugu)  1 sprig Curry leaves  1 pinch Asafoetida (hing)
instructions: To begin making the Beetroot Chutney recipe, heat oil in pan.Add bengal gram and black gram, saute them till both lentils become golden in colour. Make sure you don’t burn them.Now add asafoetida, curry leaves and saute it for a few seconds.Add grated beetroot and chopped green chillies. Saute them for 5 to 6 minutes or till the raw aroma of beetroot goes away.Switch off the flame and add grated coconut, mix well. Let the mixture bit cool down.Once the mixture is cooled down, add it to a grinder jar. Add salt, some water and grind it in a smooth paste.Take the smooth paste in a bowl. Now we will start making the tempering for chutney.Heat oil in a tadka pan. Add mustard seeds and let them crackle.Now add curry leaves and pinch of asafoetida, mix well and switch off flame. Pour the tempering over beetroot chutney mixture. Mix well and Beetroot Chutney is ready to be served.Serve Beetroot Chutney along with Keerai Sambar and Steamed rice for a healthy and tasty weekday lunch or dinner.

name: Pear And Alfalfa Sprouts Salad Recipe
description: The Pear And Alfalfa Sprouts Salad makes a perfect summer meal. It is fresh, light and has the perfect balance of nutrients. When it's the peak of summer spicy, oily food is out of everyone's mind. To beat the heat, smoothies, salads and light food are the best for your body.
ingredients_name: Pears, Alfalfa Sprouts, Roasted Peanuts (Moongphali), Basil leaves, Brie cheese, Balsamic Vinegar, Black pepper powder, Salt
ingredients_quantity: 2 Pears , crispy green  1/2 cup Alfalfa Sprouts  1 tablespoon Roasted Peanuts (Moongphali) , coarsely pounded  4 Basil leaves , shredded  1 tablespoon Brie cheese , thinly sliced (optional)  1 tablespoon Balsamic Vinegar  1/2 teaspoon Black pepper powder Salt , to taste
instructions: To begin making the Pear And Alfalfa Sprouts Salad, wash and slice pears in thin slices and add it to a large salad bowl.Combine all ingredients together along with the sliced pears until just about combined. Make sure the sprouts and pear are dry. Wet ingredients can lead to limp salads.Serve the Pear And Alfalfa Sprouts along with a warm toasted garlic bread and Vegetable Clear Soup With Lemon Grass Recipe for light or dinner, garnished with a few basil leaves for a light lunch or dinner.

name: Chana dal and fenugreek vegetable recipe - Chana Dal & Methi Ki Sabzi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Chana dal and fenugreek vegetable is a simple vegetable in which gram dal and fenugreek are cooked with mosters. This vegetable is good for health and work can be made in time. Serve chana dal and fenugreek vegetables with Gujarati Kadhi and Phulka.
ingredients_name: Chana dal, fenugreek seeds, water, cumin, ray, asafetida, kadhi leaves, red chili powder, turmeric powder, mango powder, coriander powder, salt, oil
ingredients_quantity: 1 cup gram gram dal 1/4 cup fenugreek seeds, 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1/2 teaspoon teaspoon 1/2 teaspoon asafetida 4 teaspoon leaves 1 teaspoon red chili powder 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 1/2 teaspoon of Amchur powder 1/2 teaspoon of coriander powder salt, use oil, use
instructions: To make gram dal and fenugreek vegetables, first boil gram dal and fenugreek seeds together. Cook until it is soft. Give the water out and keep it separately. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cumin, rye, asafetida and curry leaves to it. After 10 seconds, add gram and fenugreek. After 1 minute, add red chili powder, turmeric powder, mangoes, coriander powder and salt. Mix it well and cook for the next 3 to 5 minutes. Finally turn off the gas and garnish the vegetable with green coriander. Serve chana dal and fenugreek vegetables with Gujarati Kadhi and Phulka.

name: Paneer Do Pyaza Recipe - Paneer Do Pyaza (Recipe in Hindi)
description: In Persian of two onions, it means two onions and it is double the amount of onion in the vegetable, so this vegetable is called Paneer two onion. In this vegetable, onion is put in two places in recipe. It is very famous in the vegetable restaurant and is more in the menu of North Indian hotels.
ingredients_name: Cheese, oil, onion, onion, tomatoes, cumin, cardamom, ginger garlic paste, turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder, kasoori fenugreek, garam masala powder, cream, salt
ingredients_quantity: Cut 1 cup cheese, cut oil, take 1-1/2 onion according to the experiment, cut 1 onion, cut 2-1/2 tomatoes, finely chop 1 teaspoon cumin seed 1-1 1/4 cup cream, heavy whipping salt, according to taste
instructions: To make the cheese two piazas, heat the oil in a pan. Add onion to it and cook them until they become soft. After soft, come out separately and keep them. Heat the oil separately in a pan. Add cumin and cardamom to it and cook it for 10 seconds. Now add chopped onion directly and cook until it becomes soft. Add garlic ginger paste to it and cook for 1 minute. After 1 minute add tomatoes and cook until it becomes soft. Add spices, kasoori fenugreek, salt and mix well. Cook the gravy for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, add paneer, ripe onion and mix. Now add some cream to it and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.

name: राजमा सागवाला रेसिपी - Dry Kidney Beans And Spinach Stir Fry (Recipe In Hindi)
description: राजमा सगवाला एक प्रोटीन रिच सब्ज़ी है जिसमे राजमा को पालक के साथ पकाया जाता है. यह सब्ज़ी आप अपने और अपने बच्चो के लंच बॉक्स में भी पैक कर सकते है.
ingredients_name: राजमा, पालक, तेल, जीरा, प्याज, लहसुन, हरी मिर्च, हल्दी पाउडर, गरम मसाला पाउडर , हींग, नमक

instructions: राजमा सागवाला बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले राजमा को पूरी रत भिगो ले. भिगोने के बाद उसे प्रेशर कुकर में 2 सिटी आने तक पका ले. अलग से रख दे. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें जीरा, हींग डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने दे. अब इसमें कटा हुआ लहसुन डाले और 20 सेकण्ड्स तक पकाए। 20 सेकण्ड्स के बाद प्याज, हरी मिर्च डाले और प्याज के नरम होने तक पकाए। प्याज के नरम होने के बाद कटा हुआ पालक, पका हुआ राजमा डाले और मिलाए। अब इसमें हल्दी पाउडर, गरम मसाला पाउडर, नमक डाले और मिला ले. 10 मिनट तक पकाए और बिच बिच में हिलाते रहे. उसके बाद गैस बंद करें और गरमा गरम परोसे। राजमा सगवाला को गुजराती दाल, कचुम्बर सलाद और फुल्के के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Junka Recipe - Spicy Gram Flour Sabzi (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Junka is a famous vegetable of Maharashtra which is made from gram flour. You can create this vegetable when the vegetables in your fridge are over. It takes very few ingredients to make it and this work is also ready in time.
ingredients_name: Besan, onion, garlic, green chillies, coriander, rye, cumin, red chili powder, oil, salt, water
ingredients_quantity: Cut fine 1/2 cup gram flour 2 onion, finely chop 5 bud garlic, peel and finely chop 1 green chili, finely chop 5 twigs green coriander, finely chop 1 teaspoon -teaspoon cumin 1 teaspoon cumin 1 teaspoon cumin 1 teaspoon red chili powder oil, salt according to use salt, 1 cup of water, lukewarm as per use, 1 cup of water, lukewarm
instructions: To make Junkka, first heat oil in the pan. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds and cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, add garlic to it and cook until it turns brown. After that add onion and green chillies and cook until the onion is soft. After soft, add red chili powder, gram flour and cook on medium flame. After 2 minutes, add salt and lukewarm water and keep stirring. Cook for 10 minutes until all the water is released. Push the pan and cook for 5 minutes. Remove the lid from the pan and cook the next 5 minutes. Add some more oil between this. Mix and garnish with green coriander. Serve Junka for dinner with lentils, furious churi and phulka.

name: बीटरूट थोरन रेसिपी - Beetroot Thoran (Recipe In Hindi)
description: थोरन को केरला में पुरे खाने के साथ साइड डिश के जैसे बनाया जाता है. इसमें सब्ज़ी को काटकर नारियल और मसालो के साथ पकाया जाता है. थोरन हर त्यौहार में भी बनाया जाता है. बीटरूट थोरन में बीटरूट को बारीक काटकर नारियल के साथ पकाते है. इसमें बाद इसमें कढ़ी पत्ता और राइ से तड़का दिया जाता है.

ingredients_quantity: 500 ग्राम्स बीटरूट , बारीक काट ले  1 कप नारियल , कस ले  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  2 सुखी लाल मिर्च  , तोड़  2 हरी मिर्च , बिच में से काट ले  1 बड़ा चमच्च सफेद उरद दाल (split)  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता  नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  1 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर   1 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1-1/2 छोटा चमच्च धनिया पाउडर  नारियल का तेल  , प्रयोग अनुसार  1 कप पानी
instructions: बीटरूट थोरन बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम कर ले. 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें कटी हुई बीटरूट डाले और पकाए। 1 कप पानी डाले, कढ़ाई को धक् ले और बीटरूट को पकने दे. बीटरूट के पाक जाने के बाद, उसे निकल ले और पानी को फेक दे. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ, उरद दाल, कढ़ी पत्ता, सुखी लाल मिर्च और हरी मिर्च डाले। 15 सेकण्ड्स तक पकाए। 15 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें बीटरूट डाले और 1 मिनट तक पकाए।उसके बाद इसमें नारियल, नमक, लाल मिर्च पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, धनिया पाउडर डाले और मिला ले. कढ़ाई को ढके और अगले 3 से 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. पक जाने के बाद, गैस बंद करें और नारियल से गार्निश करें। बीटरूट थोरन को मिक्स्ड वेजिटेबल सांबर और चावल के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: फूल गोभी का थोरन रेसिपी - Kerala Style Cauliflower (Recipe In Hindi)
description: थोरन को केरला में पुरे खाने के साथ साइड डिश के जैसे बनाया जाता है. इसमें सब्ज़ी को काटकर नारियल और मसालो के साथ पकाया जाता है. थोरन हर त्यौहार में भी बनाया जाता है. फूल गोभी के थोरन में गोभी को काटकर नारियल के साथ पकाते है. इसमें बाद इसमें कढ़ी पत्ता और राइ का तड़का दिया जाता है.
ingredients_name: गोभी, प्याज, नारियल का तेल , सफेद उरद दाल (split), राइ, जीरा, कढ़ी पत्ता , नारियल, हरी मिर्च, नमक, हल्दी पाउडर
ingredients_quantity: 1 गोभी , बारीक काट ले  4 प्याज , बारीक काट ले  1 बड़ा चमच्च नारियल का तेल   1 छोटा चमच्च सफेद उरद दाल (split)  1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1 छोटा चमच्च जीरा  12 कढ़ी पत्ता   4 बड़ा चमच्च नारियल  4 हरी मिर्च , काट ले नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर
instructions: फूल गोभी का थोरन बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम कर ले. इसमें राइ डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स बाद इसमें जीरा और उरद दाल डाले। जब उरद दाल भूरी हो जाए इसमें प्याज डाले। प्याज नरम होने के बाद इसमें हरी मिर्च, हल्दी पाउडर, कढ़ी पत्ता और कटी हुई फूल गोभी डाले। नमक डाले और गोभी के नरम होने तक पकाए। नरम होने के बाद नारियल डाले, मिलाए और 2 मिनट तक पकाए। 2 मिनट के बाद, गैस बंद करें और गरमा गरम परोसे। फूल गोभी के थोरन को मिक्स्ड वेजिटेबल सांबर और चावल के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Brinjal and capsicum vegetable recipe - Brinjal Capsicum Sabji (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Brinjal and capsicum vegetable is an easy vegetable in which brinjal and capsicum are cooked with tomatoes. You can also pack this vegetable with roti or paratha in your lunch box. Rose spices are used in this vegetable which makes this vegetable even more tasty.
ingredients_name: Brinjal, capsicum (green), garlic, asafetida, green chillies, tomatoes, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala powder, salt, green coriander, oil
ingredients_quantity: 2 brinjal, long cut 1 capsicum (green), cut 5 garlic, finely chop 1/2 tablespoons asafetida 2 green chillies, cut 1 tomato, cut 1 tablespoon turmeric powder
instructions: To make brinjal and capsicum vegetable, first heat the oil in a pan. Now add garlic and asafoetida and cook for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds, add brinjal and capsicum to it. Cook 2 and then add all the spices. Cook for 2 to 4 minutes and then add tomatoes. Cook until the vegetables are soft. After soft, add salt according to taste, cook for 1 minute and garnish with green coriander. Serve brinjal and capsicum vegetable with Panchmail Dal, Bundi Raita and Tawa Paratha for the day's dinner.

name: Raw Ka Thoron Recipe - Raw Banana Thoran (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Thorran of raw banana is often made in Kerala with food. Whenever a vegetarian comes to the name of Kerala, Thoron cannot be forgotten. In this, the raw banana is cooked with coconut and then the mustard and curry leaves are torn. It is very easy to make and you can also pack it in your lunch box.
ingredients_name: Raw bananas, coconut oil, rye, dry red chili, curry leaves, small onions, garlic, turmeric powder, coconut, green chillies, green coriander, salt
ingredients_quantity: 2 raw bananas, boil 1 teaspoon coconut oil 1 teaspoon of coconut oil 1 teaspoon mustard seeds 8 dry chilli leaves 10 small onion, finely chop 2 bud garlic, finely chop 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric powder 1/4 cup to grind 1/4 cup coconut, tighten 2 green chillies 1/4 cup green coriander, cut green coriander, cut green coriander, cut the cut, cut off
instructions: To make a thorn of raw banana, first cut the raw banana half and cook in the pressure cooker till 3 to 4 cities. After cooking, take out its peel and cut it. Put the grinding material in a mixer grinder and make a paste. Now heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds. After 15 seconds, add dry red chili, curry leaves, onion and garlic. Cook until the onion becomes soft. After the onion becomes soft, add raw banana and ground coconut and mix. Add salt and cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Then turn off the gas and serve hot. Serve raw banana thores with tomato onion sambar, rice and papad for the day's dinner.

name: शिमला मिर्च उसिली रेसिपी - Tamil Nadu Style Capsicum With Lentils Spice Mix (Recipe In Hindi)
description: उसिलि तमिल नाडु की एक प्रसिद्ध रेसिपी है, इसमें दालो को मसलो के साथ पकाया जाता है. इसे अधिकतर बीन्स के साथ पकाया जाता है लेकिन यहाँ हम इसे शिमला मिर्च के साथ पकाएंगे। बनाने में आसान और स्वाद में अच्छी, इस सब्ज़ी को आप अपने दक्षिण भारतीय खाने के साथ परोस सकते है.
ingredients_name: पिली मूंग दाल , शिमला मिर्च (हरी), सुखी लाल मिर्च , सौंफ , राइ, सफेद उरद दाल (split), कढ़ी पत्ता , हींग, नमक
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप पिली मूंग दाल  , 1 घंटे के लिए भिगो दे  2 शिमला मिर्च (हरी) , बारीक काट ले  2 सुखी लाल मिर्च   1 छोटा चमच्च सौंफ   1 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1/2 छोटा चमच्च सफेद उरद दाल (split)  1 टहनी कढ़ी पत्ता   1 हींग , चुटकी भर नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: शिमला मिर्च उसिली बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले मूंग दाल को धो कर 1 घंटे के लिए भिगो दे. पानी निकले और सुखी लाल मिर्च, सौंफ और नमक के साथ मिक्सर ग्राइंडर में पीस ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करे और उसमे राइ और उरद दाल डाले। 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकने के बाद उसमे हींग और कढ़ी पत्ता डाले। अब इसमें शिमला मिर्च और नमक डाले और अच्छी तरह से मिला दे. 3 से 5 मिनट तक पकने दे. शिमला मिर्च को एक बाउल में निकाले और अलग से रह दे. उसी कढ़ाई में थोड़ा और तेल डाले और मिर्च और दाल का पेस्ट डाले। 6 से 8 मिनट तक पकाए।अब इसमें पाकी हुई शिमला मिर्च डाले और अच्छी तरह से मिला दे. 5 मिनट के लिए और पकाए और गरमा गरम परोसे। शिमला मिर्च उसिली को टमाटर प्याज सांबर, चावल और पापड़ के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: Embroidery Mushroom Recipe - Kadai Mushroom (Recipe in Hindi)
description: Embroidery mushroom is a sharp and tasty vegetable, but you can reduce or reduce the quantity of spices according to you. Button mushroom is used in this, but here we have used Portobello Mushroom. In this vegetable, the musher is cut and cooked in tomato and garlic gravy. Capsicum is also used in it, which makes this vegetable even more tasty.
ingredients_name: Button mushroom, onion, tomato, capsicum (green), green chillies, ginger, garlic, green coriander, cumin, fenugreek seeds, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, bay, long, full black pepper, lentil sugar, oil, salt, water
ingredients_quantity: 400 Grams Button Mushroom 1 onion, Finely Cut 3 Tomatoes, Cut 1 Shimla Chilli (Green), Finely Cut 3 Green Chilli, Cut 1/2 inch Ginger 3 Long Garlic Green Coriander, Cut, Cut, 1 A Hrifsgest for Garnish, 1 St. 1/2 teaspoon of fenugreek seeds 1 teaspoon of fenugree 2 bottom leaf 4 long 4 whole black pepper 1 lentil sugar, 2 tablespoons of salt, water according to taste, puree
instructions: To make embroidery mushrooms, first wash the mushroom 4 to 5 times. Cut it after washing. Now take the jar and add tomatoes, garlic, ginger and some water to it. Grind it and make a thick paste. Now heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, bay leaves, fenugreek seeds, long, black pepper, lentils and green chillies. Cook on medium heat for 15 seconds. After 15 seconds, add onion and cook until it softens. After soft, add capsicum to it and cook for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes, add tomato puree to it and mix. Cook until boiled and then add turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder and salt. Cook for 2 minutes and then add chopped mushrooms. Mix well and then cook until the mushrooms become soft. After cooking, turn off the gas and garnish with green coriander. Serve the pan for dinner with dal tadka, Burani Raita and Tawa Paratha.

name: पत्ता गोभी और गाजर का थोरन रेसिपी - Cabbage And Carrot Thoran (Recipe In Hindi)
description: पत्ता गोभी और गाजर का थोरन एक सरल केरला रेसिपी है जिसे चावल के साथ परोसा जाता है. इसमें पत्ता गोबी और गाजर को नारियल और मसलो के साथ पकाया जाता है. यह स्वादिष्ठ रेसिपी है जिसे बनाने में बहुत कम समय लगता है.
ingredients_name: गाजर, पत्ता गोभी, प्याज, हरी मिर्च, हल्दी पाउडर, जीरा पाउडर , तेल, राइ, नारियल, कढ़ी पत्ता , नमक
ingredients_quantity: 3 गाजर , कसा हुआ  1/2 पत्ता गोभी , बारीक काट ले  1 प्याज , बारीक काट ले  4 हरी मिर्च , बिच में से काट ले  1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1 छोटा चमच्च जीरा पाउडर   1 बड़ा चमच्च तेल  1/2 छोटा चमच्च राइ  1/2 कप नारियल , कसा हुआ  6 कढ़ी पत्ता  नमक , प्रयोग अनुसार
instructions: पत्ता गोभी और गाजर का थोरन बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले पत्ता गोभी और गाजर को धो ले और काट ले. अब एक बाउल ले. उसमे गाजर, पत्ता गोभी, प्याज, हरी मिर्च, जीरा पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर और नमक डाले। सबको मिला ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। इसमें राइ डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकाए। उसके बाद इसमें कढ़ी पत्ता और सब्ज़ियो का मिक्सचर डाले। मिलाए, कढ़ाई को ढके और इससे 10 से 12 मिनट तक पकने दे. जब सब्ज़िया नरम हो जाए, इसमें कैसा हुआ नारियल डाले।मिला ले और अगले 3 मिनट तक पकाए। 3 मिनट बाद गैस बंद करें और परोसे। पत्ता गोभी और गाजर के थोरन को मिक्स्ड वेजिटेबल सांबर, चावल और घी के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: हरे टमाटर की सब्ज़ी रेसिपी - No Onion No Garlic Raw Tomato Curry (Recipe In Hindi)
description: हरे टमाटर की सब्ज़ी खट्टी, तीखी और स्वादिष्ठ सब्ज़ी है जो आप दाल के आठ बना सकते है. यह सब्ज़ी अक्सर उत्तर भारत में बनाई जाती है. हरे टमाटर को कच्चा टमाटर भी बोलते है. इस सब्ज़ी में कच्चे टमाटर को काटकर, रोज के मसलो के साथ पकाया जाता है. हरे टमाटर की सब्ज़ी को राजस्थान, उत्तर प्रदेश और बिहार में बहुत बनाया जाता है.
ingredients_name: कच्चा टमाटर, तेल, जीरा, राइ, हींग, सुखी लाल मिर्च , हरी मिर्च, हल्दी पाउडर, लाल मिर्च पाउडर , धनिया पाउडर , जीरा पाउडर , गरम मसाला पाउडर , कसूरी मेथी, नमक

instructions: हरे टमाटर की सब्ज़ी बनाने के लिए, एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम कर ले. इसमें हींग, राइ, जीरा डाले और 10 सेकण्ड्स तक पकाए। अब इसमें कटे हुए कच्चे टमाटर, हरी मिर्च डाले और मिला ले. तेज आंच पर टमाटर के नरम होने तक पकाए। नरम होने के बाद इसमें नमक, लाल मिर्च पाउडर, धनिया पाउडर, हल्दी पाउडर, जीरा पाउडर और गरम मसाला पाउडर डाले। सबको मिला ले और धक् ले. 3 से 5 मिनट तक पकाए और फिर कसूरी मेथी डाले। मिलाए और गरमा गरम परोसे।  हरे टमाटर की सब्ज़ी को दाल तड़का, बूंदी रायता और फुल्के के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: गोअन स्टाइल ब्रिंजल भरता रेसिपी - Goan Style Brinjal Bharta (Recipe In Hindi)
description: गोअन स्टाइल ब्रिंजल भरता में बैंगन को चारकोल पर पकाया जाता है. आप बैंगन को ओवन में भी सेक सकते है. प्याज और इमली से इस रेसिपी का स्वाद और भी बाद जाता है. गोअन स्टाइल ब्रिंजल भरता को रायता या दाल के साथ परोस सकते है. यह बनाने में आसान है और आपके रोज के खाने का स्वाद और भी बढ़ा देता है.
ingredients_name: बैंगन, प्याज, हरी मिर्च, हरा धनिया, इमली का पेस्ट, नारियल, इमली, नमक, तेल
ingredients_quantity: 1 बैंगन  2 प्याज , बारीक काट ले  2 हरी मिर्च , काट ले  1/2 कप हरा धनिया , बारीक काट ले  1 बड़ा चमच्च इमली का पेस्ट  2 बड़ा चमच्च नारियल , कसा हुआ  1 इमली , मार्बल के जितना नमक , स्वाद अनुसार  1 बड़ा चमच्च तेल
instructions: गोअन स्टाइल ब्रिंजल भरता बनाने के लिए, बैंगन को साफ़ कर ले और उसमे 4 चीरे लगा ले. अब एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। बैंगन पर तेल लगाए, कढ़ाई में रखे और धक् ले. 2 मिनट बाद, कढ़ाई को खोले और बैंगन को पलट दे.अब बैंगन के एक चीरे में इमली डाले और कढ़ाई को फिर से धक् ले. बैंगन को पलटते रहे जब तक वो चारो तरफ से पाक जाए.  पकने के बाद, बैंगन थोड़ा भूरा हो जाएगा और पानी छोड़ेगा। बैंगन को ठंडा होने तक ढके रहने दे. ठन्डे होने के बाद, इसको छिले और अला से रख दे.अब बैंगन को मैश कर ले और इसमें प्याज और हरी मिर्च मिला ले. इसमें कैसा हुआ नारियल डाले और अच्छी तरह से मिला ले. इमली का पेस्ट, नमक मिलाए और हरे धनिये से गार्निश करें। गोअन स्टाइल ब्रिंजल भरता को गुजराती कढ़ी, खीचिया छुरी और फुल्के के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: गोभी और लाल शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी रेसिपी - Cauliflower And Red Bell Pepper Stir Fry (Recipe In Hindi)
description: गोभी और लाल शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी एक सरल सब्ज़ी है जिसमे बहुत नुट्रिएंट्स भी है. कम तेल के साथ गोभी और शिमला मिर्च को रोज के मसालो के साथ पकाया जाता है. इस सब्ज़ी को आप अपने बच्चो के लंच बॉक्स में भी डाल सकते है.
ingredients_name: गोभी, शिमला मिर्च (लाल), धनिया पाउडर , लाल मिर्च पाउडर , हल्दी पाउडर, गरम मसाला पाउडर , कसूरी मेथी, तेल, नमक
ingredients_quantity: 1 कप गोभी , छोटा काट ले  1 शिमला मिर्च (लाल) , पतला और सीधा काट ले  1 छोटा चमच्च धनिया पाउडर   1 छोटा चमच्च लाल मिर्च पाउडर   1/2 छोटा चमच्च हल्दी पाउडर  1/2 छोटा चमच्च गरम मसाला पाउडर   1 छोटा चमच्च कसूरी मेथी , क्रश कर ले  2 छोटा चमच्च तेल नमक , स्वाद अनुसार
instructions: गोभी और लाल शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी बनाने के लिए सबसे पहले गोभी को गरम पानी में डाले। इसमें नमक और हल्दी पाउडर डाले। २ मिनट के लिए तेज आंच पर पकाए और अलग से रख दे.एक कढ़ाई में तेल गरम करें। उसमे सारे मसाले और नमक डाले और 30 सेकण्ड्स तक पकाए। अब इसमें गोभी डाले और 5 से 6 मिनट तक पकाए। जब गोभी थोड़ा पक जाए, इसमें लाल शिमला मिर्च डाले और अच्छी तरह से से मिलाए। इसको 5 मिनट तक पकाए और गैस बंद कर ले.इसमें कसूरी मेथी डाले और मिला ले. गरमा गरम परोसे। गोभी और लाल शिमला मिर्च की सब्ज़ी को दाल फ्राई और फुल्के के साथ दिन के खाने के लिए परोसे।

name: सुखी दही वाली लौकी रेसिपी - Yogurt Based Bottle Gourd Sabzi (Recipe In Hindi)
description: सुखी दही वाली लौकी की सब्ज़ी में लौकी को दही और मसलो के साथ पकाया जाता है. दूधी गर्मियों के लिए बहुत अच्छी होती है इसलिए इसे ज्यादा इस मौसम में बनाया जाता है.
ingredients_name: लौकी, जीरा, राइ, कढ़ी पत्ता , हरी मिर्च, लहसुन, प्याज, टमाटर, दही, लाल मिर्च पाउडर , हल्दी पाउडर, धनिया पाउडर , नमक, पानी , तेल
